Job description At SLS The Red Sea, every detail matters — and every riyal counts. As a Cost Controller, you will play a key role in monitoring costs, controlling inventory, analyzing spending, and ensuring the hotel operates efficiently without compromising the exceptional experiences we create for our guests. Working closely with Finance, Procurement, F&B, Culinary, and other operational teams, you will provide accurate cost insights, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure strong financial controls across the hotel. Key responsibilities Monitor daily costs and expenses across hotel departments, with a strong focus on F&B operations. Review and analyze food and beverage costs, consumption, wastage, and inventory movement. Conduct and audit regular inventories, stock counts, transfers, and spoilage reports. Compare actual costs against budgets and forecasts, investigate variances, and highlight areas requiring action. Work closely with Procurement to review purchase prices, purchase orders, and supplier-related cost information. Review storeroom procedures, consumption records, and internal transfers to ensure accurate cost allocation and control. Coordinate with Culinary and F&B teams on recipe costing, portion control, and menu cost analysis. Prepare regular cost reports, including food cost, beverage cost, inventory movement, and other operational cost indicators. Identify opportunities to reduce wastage, improve efficiency, and strengthen cost-control practices. Support month-end closing activities, including inventory valuation, journal entries, accruals, and reconciliations. Maintain accurate and audit-ready cost-control records and supporting documentation. Ensure all cost-control activities follow hotel policies, internal controls, and Finance procedures. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Previous experience in Cost Control, Finance, or a similar role, preferably within the hospitality industry. Good understanding of cost accounting, inventory control, and F&B operations. Experience with hospitality systems such as FMC, Adaco, FutureLog, Materials Control, Sun Systems, Opera, or Micros is an advantage. Strong Microsoft Excel and analytical skills. Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify cost variances and trends. Good communication and coordination skills with the ability to work across operational departments. Ability to meet deadlines and work effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

Overview We are seeking a curator of art and culture to join the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra). The King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra) is a leading cultural institution dedicated to enriching lives through culture, creativity, knowledge, and learning. Through its museums, exhibitions, educational programs, conferences, and cultural initiatives, Ithra preserves and promotes cultural heritage while creating meaningful experiences that inspire local and international audiences. Ithra is committed to presenting world-class museum experiences that connect history, creativity, and innovation while fostering dialogue and cross-cultural understanding. Your primary role is to develop, manage, and interpret art exhibitions, collections, and cultural initiatives that present art as a living tradition. You will bridge the historical and contemporary dimensions of art by delivering world-class exhibitions, strengthening local and international collaborations, advancing research and scholarship, developing educational programs, and creating engaging museum experiences that resonate with diverse audiences while supporting the preservation and appreciation of cultural heritage. Duties and responsibilities Manage the research, curation, content development, interpretation, and delivery of permanent, temporary, inaugural, and traveling art exhibitions from concept through implementation. Develop compelling exhibition narratives that connect historical collections with contemporary artistic and cultural practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Ithra to plan, develop, and deliver exhibition projects, conferences, and cultural programs. Manage the development of content, educational vision, interpretation, and programmatic plans for dedicated civilization galleries and interactive museum spaces. Oversee the growth, preservation, documentation, and stewardship of permanent and temporary art collections, including securing and managing significant long-term loans and historical installations. Assess art objects and historical architectural elements to support collection management, conservation planning, exhibition development, and interpretation. Establish, develop, and maintain collaborative partnerships with local and international museums, galleries, cultural institutions, researchers, and subject matter experts. Conduct scholarly research and develop publications, books, exhibition catalogues, and interpretive content related to art, aesthetics, visual culture, and traditional crafts. Develop and facilitate educational programs, community workshops, symposia, conferences, open lectures, and public engagement initiatives that promote the preservation and revival of traditional arts and crafts. Conduct audience research to understand visitor needs and develop exhibitions that are accessible, engaging, and relevant to diverse local and international audiences. Manage contracts and coordinate the work of external designers, artisans, consultants, and service providers to develop exhibition components and interactive displays. Provide curatorial expertise and guidance to multidisciplinary project teams while managing project budgets, schedules, resources, and stakeholder engagement. Represent Ithra at regional and international conferences, professional forums, networking events, and cultural engagements to strengthen institutional partnerships and promote art and culture. Minimum requirements You will hold a bachelor’s degree in art, art history, museum studies, or a related discipline from a recognized and approved program. A master’s degree or PhD is preferred. You will have 10–15 years of experience in art curation, museum management, cultural heritage, or museum exhibitions, including at least 5 years managing major museum exhibitions, gallery development, collection management, or curatorial programs. You will have demonstrated expertise in art, history, visual culture, and cultural heritage. You will have experience curating art collections, developing exhibitions, and managing museum collections within a major museum or cultural institution. You will have experience establishing partnerships and collaborating with local and international museums, galleries, cultural institutions, and subject matter experts. You will have a strong record of scholarly research, publications, books, or exhibition catalogues related to art. You will have experience managing multidisciplinary teams, project budgets, contracts, and external service providers. You will possess strong communication, writing, presentation, and public speaking skills. You will have the ability to engage diverse audiences through educational programming, audience research, and innovative museum experiences. You must be willing to travel internationally for research, networking, institutional collaboration, and collection acquisition. Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in Arabic or another language relevant to the world is highly desirable. Formal training or certifications in museology, museum studies, or art conservation are preferred. Requirements for Compound Manager / General Manager: The ideal candidate must be suited for the role of Compound Manager / General Manager, who is the single most critical onsite leadership position responsible for the strategic and operational management of the compound (apartments, villas, and suites), commercial units, and extensive amenity facilities (cinema, restaurant, gym, spa, swimming pools, sports courts, and green spaces) across a 259,797 sqm site. This role requires a seasoned property management professional with deep operational expertise in mixed-use or large-scale residential communities, proven leadership capability, financial acumen, and the cultural awareness necessary to manage high-quality residential assets in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will serve as the primary point of contact for the client, ensuring the compound operates as a premier lifestyle destination that justifies its premium positioning within Riyadh's competitive residential market. Job Description: The Compound Manager will provide unified leadership across all functions, including property management, facilities management (through FM integration), financial administration, leasing, customer experience, health & safety, compliance, and community engagement, whilst maintaining transparent, proactive communication with the client and delivering measurable performance against defined KPIs including 95%+ occupancy, 85%+ resident satisfaction (NPS), and cost control within approved budgets. The role is to report directly to the Senior Director - Head of Building Management (PAMS). Representing the onsite PM team. This will involve leading and overseeing the quality assurance and quality control of the day-to-day property management services, operations, transitions management (which involves taking the building into a multi-let asset), in accordance with the best practices in the industry. The candidate shall be able to confidently oversee the provision of OPEX and CAPEX budgeting requirements, overview financial forecasts and P&L’s; prepare and submit weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reports to the clients; the preparation of governance documents, property operations plan, guidelines, property regulations/rules, policies and procedures, procurement request for approvals, etc. The candidate shall be knowledgeable and confident enough to lead a team and consult with clients, tenants, and contractors, exercising good negotiation skills with experienced professionals in multinational organisations and international tenants. The candidate will be responsible for the maintenance and accuracy of the property management systems (CRM/BMS/CAFM) and ensure that the TFM service providers are keeping systems up to date and that the TFM staff receive training and advice on using the systems. The candidate will be responsible for liaising and advising the clients on changes to local law and legislation that may affect the operations of the property and seek approval and direction on implementing / cascading directives that will affect the day-to-day operations of the site. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Leadership & Stakeholder Management Serve as the client’s single point of contact for all operational, financial, and strategic matters relating to the compound. Develop and implement annual Property Operating Plans aligned with the client's investment objectives and Vision 2030 commitments. Maintain proactive, transparent communication with the leadership team through structured monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting cycles. Build and maintain professional relationships with key stakeholders including government ministries (MoMRA, Civil Defence, Ministry of Labour), local authorities (Riyadh Municipality), utilities, and community representatives. Lead annual business planning processes, incorporating market intelligence, demographic trends, and competitive positioning analysis to inform strategic decision-making. Represent JLL's values of teamwork, ethics, and excellence, ensuring the compound's brand reputation as Riyadh's premier residential destination. 2. Operational Excellence & Service Delivery Oversee seamless integration of all property management functions (leasing, financial administration, resident services, community engagement) with facilities management operations (hard and soft FM services). Ensure consistent service quality across all touchpoints through standardized operating procedures, quality assurance programs, and mystery shopping validation. Implement and maintain comprehensive Property Operating Plan covering all operational aspects including HSE protocols, emergency response plans, business continuity plans, risk management frameworks, and performance measurement systems. Coordinate daily cross-functional alignment meetings with the Facility Manager, Property Manager, Finance Manager, Leasing Manager, and Community Engagement Manager to ensure unified service delivery. Conduct weekly site inspections and audits across residential units, amenity facilities, common areas, and landscaping to validate maintenance standards and identify improvement opportunities. Manage compound-wide delivery standards including cleaning protocols (BICSc standards), landscaping and irrigation management, pest control programs, waste management and recycling initiatives, and security operations. 3. Financial Management & Budget Control Assume full P&L accountability for the compound's operations, optimizing Net Operating Income (NOI) through revenue maximization and cost control whilst maintaining service excellence. Prepare and submit OPEX and CAPEX budgets 60 days prior to year-end with detailed justification, market benchmarking, and alignment to the client’s financial objectives. Monitor financial performance against approved budgets, maintaining variances within ±15% tolerance requirements. Provide clear escalation to the client for any anticipated variances ?10% or unbudgeted expenditure, with written approval required. Oversee procurement activities ensuring value-for-money, compliance with governance requirements and transparent vendor selection processes. Validate all monthly financial reporting including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, accounts receivable/payable aging, service charge reconciliations, and budget variance analysis delivered within 15 days of month-end. Manage capital investment planning through comprehensive lifecycle assessments, identifying improvement initiatives including unit upgrades, amenity enhancements, operational efficiency projects, and revenue-generating opportunities with detailed business cases and ROI analysis. 4. Leasing & Revenue Optimization Drive occupancy optimization targeting 95%+ physical occupancy through proactive leasing strategies, resident retention programs and minimization of void periods. Oversee integrated leasing platform combining dedicated onsite leasing team with Residential Brokerage Services, leveraging corporate networks across KSA and MENA to generate qualified prospect pipeline. Manage and protect critical corporate and government housing contracts through proactive renewal discussions commencing 6-9 months prior to expiry, dedicated account management, and flexible lease structures accommodating corporate rotation cycles. Ensure full compliance with Saudi Arabia's five-year rent freeze regulations and REGA requirements including 100% Ejar platform registration for all lease contracts. Implement strategic marketing initiatives including digital campaigns, corporate outreach, resident referral program, and broker engagement to maintain continuous leasing pipeline. Monitor leasing performance metrics including lead conversion rates, average days to lease, turn times (notice-to-lease-ready), and renewal rates with data-driven strategy refinement. Customer Experience & Community Engagement Champion exceptional resident experience as the foundation for retention, referrals, and premium positioning, targeting 85%+ Net Promoter Score (NPS). Oversee Community Activities Coordinator in delivering vibrant community engagement programming across cultural celebrations, family/children's activities, health/fitness initiatives, social connection events, and lifestyle enrichment. Implement structured resident feedback mechanisms including onboarding surveys, bi-annual satisfaction surveys, exit interviews, and real-time digital feedback channels with systematic analysis and action planning. Manage comprehensive complaints procedure ensuring 24-hour acknowledgement, 15-day resolution and transparent communication building resident trust. Create inclusive community environment celebrating cultural diversity whilst respecting local customs, with programming recognizing both Western holidays and Islamic occasions (Ramadan iftars, Eid celebrations, etc.). 6. Health, Safety, Environment & Compliance Maintain comprehensive HSE Management System ensuring the compound operates at the highest safety standards, protecting residents, visitors, contractors, and staff whilst ensuring full compliance with KSA regulatory requirements. Implement quarterly reviews and continuous improvement cycles. Ensure 100% Civil Defence compliance including monthly fire safety system inspections, fire drills with performance evaluation, Civil Defence inspections with full documentation, and immediate response to any notices. Maintain current certifications for all fire and life-safety systems with proactive renewal scheduling. Manage relationships with local Civil Defence authorities, Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs (MoMRA), Riyadh Municipality, and other regulatory bodies ensuring proactive compliance and prompt response to any inspections or requirements. Ensure full regulatory compliance across all KSA requirements including MoMRA building standards, ZATCA (VAT, e-invoicing Phase 2, Zakat, WHT), SDAIA data protection, Ministry of Labour (work permits, Saudisation, WPS), and REGA (Ejar registration). Lead incident management protocols with root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and transparent communication to the client and affected stakeholders. 7. Security & Access Control Oversee integrated security operations protecting residents, assets, and reputation through professional 24/7 security personnel, technology systems, and proactive risk management. Manage the approved security contractor ensuring compliance with all security protocols, incident response procedures, and performance standards. Supervise access control operations at manned main gate with visitor management systems, contractor access protocols, vehicle registration, and emergency access procedures. Ensure comprehensive perimeter security including regular inspection of fencing/gates/barriers, scheduled and random vehicle/foot patrols, and 24/7 CCTV monitoring with recording retention. Implement robust incident management protocols including immediate escalation for serious incidents (security breaches, criminal activity, injuries, fires), investigation with root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation. Coordinate emergency security procedures including evacuation management, assembly point control, resident accountability, and liaison with local police/Civil Defence. 8. Facilities Management Integration & Contractor Supervision Provide unified governance over Facilities Management scope covering all hard services (MEP systems, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire & life safety, elevators, civil/structural, pools) and soft services (cleaning, landscaping, pest control, waste management, amenity operations). Coordinate daily operational alignment with the Facility Manager ensuring seamless integration of property management and facilities operations through shared technology platforms, standardized service delivery, and joint accountability for performance outcomes. Oversee planned preventive maintenance programs (PPM) ensuring compliance. Monitor reactive maintenance performance including 24/7 emergency response. Review vendor performance against established KPIs/SLAs including response times, quality ratings, safety compliance, and cost-effectiveness with monthly scorecards and quarterly business reviews. Drive continuous improvement through asset lifecycle planning, condition assessments, capital investment recommendations, and operational efficiency initiatives. 9. Technology Systems & Digital Innovation Champion deployment and optimization of integrated technology platforms including Property Management System, CAFM system for maintenance management, financial accounting modules, and resident portal/mobile app. Ensure data integrity through robust data migration, multi-stage validation, and comprehensive documentation with 100% accuracy requirements for resident/lease data, financial records, and asset registers. Oversee resident technology engagement including onboarding to mobile app, self-service capabilities (rent payment, maintenance requests, amenity booking), and digital communications ensuring adoption rates support operational efficiency. Identify and implement emerging property management technologies that enhance operational efficiency, sustainability performance, and resident experience. 10. ESG & Sustainability Leadership Drive Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance in alignment with sustainability objectives and commitments. Oversee energy and utilities optimization programs targeting measurable consumption reductions. Implement comprehensive water conservation and waste management measures. Champion sustainability training programs and resident engagement initiatives fostering environmental awareness and participation in compound-wide conservation efforts. 11. Team Leadership & Development Lead, motivate, and develop high-performing onsite teams including Property Managers, Finance Manager, Leasing Executives, Community Engagement Manager, Administrative Support, and coordination with the Facility Manager and operational teams. Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, identify training and development needs, and implement succession planning for key roles ensuring business continuity. Foster collaborative team culture emphasizing JLL values of teamwork, ethics, and excellence with clear accountability, open communication, and mutual respect. Implement cross-functional coordination mechanisms including daily huddles, weekly strategic planning sessions, monthly business reviews, and quarterly objective-setting ensuring alignment across all functions. Ensure full compliance with Saudi Labour Law including work permits (Iqama), employment contracts, Saudization targets, and worker welfare standards across all JLL and contractor personnel. 12. Reporting & Documentation Deliver comprehensive monthly reports. Submit quarterly strategic reviews and forward-looking forecasts. Prepare annual reports, capital expenditure analysis, market positioning assessment, sustainability performance, and comprehensive budget proposal/recommendations. Maintain centralized document repository for all operational documentation including policies/procedures, contracts, licenses/permits/certifications, insurance certificates, risk registers, inspection reports, incident logs, and meeting minutes. Provide ad-hoc reporting as required, including custom analysis, board presentation materials, investor reports, regulatory submissions, supporting strategic decision-making. Ensure all reporting meets professional standards with consistent formatting, intuitive data visualization, executive-friendly summaries, complete audit trails, and secure archival systems. Company description Join ibis budget Makkah Al Aziziah – Al Hidayah Towers Hotel, a member of the Accor network, one of the world’s leading hospitality groups bringing together more than 45 brands, 5,500 hotels, 10,000 restaurants and lifestyle destinations worldwide. At Accor, we believe in you and what you bring to the team. Job description We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Director of Sales & Marketing to lead the commercial strategy of a large-scale hotel operation in Makkah, with a primary focus on the Hajj and Umrah markets, religious tourism, individual travelers, and group business. The Director of Sales & Marketing will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to maximize occupancy, revenue, market share, and profitability throughout the Hajj and Umrah seasons. The successful candidate will have strong knowledge of the Makkah hospitality and religious tourism market, with an established understanding of Umrah operators, Hajj missions, travel agencies, tour operators, wholesalers, and key international source markets. Key responsibilities Develop and implement short-term and long-term sales and marketing strategies with a strong focus on Hajj, Umrah, religious tourism, individual travelers, and group business. Establish measurable sales targets, KPIs, and action plans for the Sales & Marketing team. Drive business from key Hajj and Umrah source markets and continuously identify opportunities to expand the hotel's geographical market reach. Develop and maintain strong relationships with Umrah operators, Hajj missions, travel agencies, tour operators, wholesalers, group organizers, and other key partners. Identify and secure new group and individual Umrah business while strengthening relationships with existing high-producing accounts. Develop specific commercial strategies for Hajj, Ramadan, peak Umrah periods, and other key religious seasons. Conduct regular market research and competitor analysis to understand demand patterns, pricing, market positioning, and emerging opportunities. Monitor competitor hotels, market trends, group movements, and Hajj and Umrah demand to recommend timely commercial actions. Work closely with Revenue Management to optimize pricing, inventory, length of stay, group allocation, market segmentation, and business mix. Evaluate group requests and business opportunities based on revenue potential, profitability, displacement, and overall hotel strategy. Develop and manage the annual Sales & Marketing budget and commercial action plan. Analyze the return on investment of sales trips, international roadshows, trade events, marketing campaigns, and business development activities. Conduct regular sales missions and business development activities in strategic domestic and international source markets. Represent the hotel at relevant Hajj and Umrah exhibitions, travel trade events, workshops, roadshows, and networking opportunities. Maintain close relationships with key decision-makers and partners within the religious tourism sector. Monitor account production, room nights, average rates, revenue contribution, conversion, and overall account performance. Identify underperforming accounts and markets and implement corrective commercial action plans. Develop strategies to increase direct and individual Umrah bookings alongside contracted group business. Work closely with Revenue, Reservations, Front Office, Finance, and Operations to ensure commercial commitments and group requirements are effectively delivered. Ensure contracts, rates, allocations, payment terms, and commercial agreements are properly managed and aligned with hotel objectives. Prepare regular commercial reports, forecasts, market intelligence, and performance analysis for hotel leadership. Lead, coach, motivate, and develop the Sales & Marketing team to maintain a strong performance and accountability culture. Ensure all Sales & Marketing activities comply with Accor brand standards, commercial guidelines, policies, and procedures. Key competencies Hajj & Umrah market expertise Religious tourism sales Group & individual business development Strategic commercial planning Key account management Revenue & profitability focus Market intelligence & competitor analysis Contract negotiation Leadership & team development International market development Data-driven decision-making Stakeholder & partner relationship management Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Proven senior-level Sales & Marketing experience within the hospitality industry, preferably in Makkah or the Saudi Arabian religious tourism market. Strong knowledge and experience in the Hajj and Umrah business is highly preferred. Established understanding of Umrah operators, Hajj missions, travel agencies, tour operators, wholesalers, and group business. Strong knowledge of major domestic and international source markets for Hajj and Umrah. Demonstrated ability to generate and develop high-volume group and individual religious tourism business. Strong understanding of hotel pricing, revenue management, contracting, forecasting, market segmentation, and distribution. Excellent commercial, negotiation, analytical, and financial skills. Strong leadership skills with proven experience in managing and developing Sales & Marketing teams. Ability to build and maintain long-term relationships with key accounts and business partners. Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Excellent command of English; Arabic language skills are highly advantageous. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for sales missions, exhibitions, and key account development.

Job description The Executive Lounge Attendant position offers a strong opportunity for individuals with a passion for hospitality and a proven background in guest service. It is particularly well suited to candidates who have gained experience as a waiter or host within a hotel environment and are looking to further develop their skills in a premium guest-service setting. This role targets service excellence in catering to the needs of guests within a dedicated hotel lounge. An Executive Lounge Attendant is expected to deliver exceptional service, demonstrating outstanding courtesy, attentiveness, and professionalism when catering to the needs of distinguished guests. The day-to-day duties of an Executive Lounge Attendant include but are not limited to: Warmly welcome and assist guests with seating arrangements. Offer detailed menu presentations and knowledgeable recommendations regarding daily specials and promotions. Accurately record and place guest orders, while advising on beverage pairings. Extend complimentary services, including drinks, and ensure guests are aware of additional offerings. Guarantee swift order execution and timely delivery to guest tables. Address and resolve inquiries and concerns about hotel and lounge services. Prepare and stock condiment stations, maintaining supply levels through coordination with procurement. Orchestrate with housekeeping staff to uphold a hygienic and sanitized lounge environment. Arrange buffet areas, ensuring food and drink presentation is both appealing and accessible. Conduct ongoing checks to secure guest satisfaction and manage further service requests. Qualifications Saudi national. Exhibit exceptional etiquette and maintain a polite, friendly demeanor. If you find fulfillment in ensuring guests receive the highest level of service and enjoy working in an upscale, fast-paced hospitality setting, the role might be the perfect next step in your career.

Job description As a senior quantity surveyor, you will be overseeing and managing the quantity surveying aspects of our road and infrastructure projects. Your expertise will be instrumental in ensuring the successful delivery of our PMC projects, maintaining the highest standards of quality and client satisfaction. Assignment duration: Until the end of 2026, with the possibility of extension. Responsibilities: Lead and manage a team of quantity surveyors, providing guidance and support. Prepare and review cost estimates, bills of quantities, and tender documents for road projects. Conduct detailed cost analysis and provide accurate cost forecasts. Negotiate and manage subcontractor agreements, ensuring compliance with project requirements. Monitor and control project costs, identifying potential cost overruns and implementing cost-saving measures. Prepare and submit progress reports, highlighting key milestones and project status. Liaise with clients, contractors, and other stakeholders to resolve cost-related issues. Ensure compliance with local regulations, standards, and contract conditions. Provide expert advice and recommendations on cost-effective solutions for road infrastructure. Maintain accurate records and documentation throughout the project lifecycle. Requirements: Minimum 10 years of experience as a quantity surveyor, with a focus on road projects. Bachelor's degree in quantity surveying, construction management, or a related field. Professional membership with a recognized institution, such as RICS or equivalent. Excellent knowledge of road construction techniques and industry practices. Strong leadership and team management skills. Proficiency in using relevant software for cost estimation and project management. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective client interaction. Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Analytical mindset with attention to detail for accurate cost analysis. Willingness to travel within Saudi Arabia for project-related activities.

Job Description The Lead Planner is responsible for driving planning and schedule reporting for the closeout portfolio. This role plays a crucial part in setting schedule standards, developing integrated schedules, and providing critical path analysis and progress reports to support closeout decisions. The Lead Planner will work closely with various teams and stakeholders to ensure effective planning and timely project completion. Assignment duration: Until the end of 2026, with the possibility of extension. Key responsibilities include: Own schedule reporting and set the reporting cycle for the closeout portfolio. Establish planning standards, coding requirements, and schedule templates. Develop and maintain integrated schedules for demobilization, preservation, and closeout. Prepare schedule forecasts, covering milestones, activities, and closure dates. Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule health assessments. Lead schedule review meetings with project, construction, and stakeholder teams. Assess schedule updates for accuracy, logic, and reported progress. Combine contract schedules into a portfolio view, identifying cross-contract dependencies. Identify schedule slippage, constraints, and forecast changes, and their impact on closeout objectives. Provide schedule substantiation for claims, disputes, and final account reviews. Qualifications and experience: Minimum 20 years of planning and scheduling experience, with 10 years in major projects in Saudi Arabia/GCC. Experience on mega-projects with multi-billion SAR portfolios and a high volume of contracts. Expertise in schedule development, review, forecasting, critical path analysis, and progress measurement. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. PMP, PMI-SP, PSP, AACE, or similar certification is preferred. Forensic planning and delay analysis experience is desirable. Owner, IPMT, PMC, or major program experience is an asset. Expertise in Primavera P6 and advanced Microsoft Excel is mandatory. Power BI development and report usage is preferred. Strong command of PowerPoint, Aconex, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365.

Project controls engineer responsibilities The project controls engineer is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely reporting of project data. This role plays a crucial part in maintaining the integrity of cost, schedule, and progress information, and supports various project functions with data analysis and reporting. Assignment duration: Until the end of 2026, with the possibility of extension. Prepare weekly and monthly reports, closeout, demobilization, and preservation reports. Collect, organize, and maintain data across contracts, including cost, schedule, and progress information. Update cost and schedule trackers, and prepare S-curves, charts, and presentation materials. Support reconciliation of SAP, Oracle Unifier, and Primavera P6 records, and manage reporting calendars. Perform variance analysis and provide commentary on changes. Assist with schedule and cost substantiation records for claims and disputes. Complete ad-hoc analysis and reporting as requested by the project controls manager. Apply document control and data quality standards to all work products. Follow up with project teams and stakeholders for inputs and evidence. Ensure confidentiality and data integrity throughout the process. Qualifications and skills Minimum 5 years of project controls experience, preferably on construction or major capital projects. Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, or related fields. Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills are mandatory. Working knowledge of Primavera P6, SAP, and Oracle Unifier is preferred. Experience with Power BI and Aconex, SharePoint, and OneDrive is an asset. Practical experience in cost, schedule, and data analysis reporting is essential. PMP or a comparable credential is desirable. Owner, IPMT, PMC, consultant, or contractor experience is preferred. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to report to executives. Ability to work independently and manage deadlines effectively.

Job overview The senior project controls engineer is a vital position, responsible for integrating and presenting critical project information. This role plays a key role in coordinating and analyzing data from various project functions, ensuring accurate and timely reporting. The successful candidate will have extensive experience in project controls, especially in integrated cost and schedule reporting, and a strong command of relevant software tools. Closeout, termination, or final account experience preferred. Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction, or a related field. PMP or similar certification is desirable. Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills are mandatory. Working knowledge of Primavera P6, SAP, Oracle Unifier, and Power BI. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially for executive reporting. Ability to work independently and manage deadlines effectively.

Lead IT Infrastructure Engineer Responsibilities The lead IT infrastructure engineer will be a key member of the IT project delivery team, responsible for owning the infrastructure domain across projects. This role represents a senior technical authority, accountable for ensuring that all infrastructure solutions are properly designed, validated, and delivered in line with organizational standards, project requirements, and governance frameworks. The candidate is expected to operate with a high level of independence, providing technical leadership, design assurance, and vendor control, while ensuring that all infrastructure deliverables are complete, compliant, and ready for handover. Infrastructure authority & ownership Act as the lead authority for infrastructure within assigned projects. Own all infrastructure-related decisions, validations, and outcomes. Ensure solutions are aligned with business needs, technical standards, and long-term sustainability. Project delivery leadership Lead the infrastructure scope across all project phases (design, implementation, validation, and closure). Ensure delivery meets agreed timelines, milestones, and quality expectations. Proactively identify risks and enforce corrective actions. Vendor governance & control Take full ownership of technical engagement with vendors and system integrators. Review, challenge, and approve all vendor deliverables. Enforce accountability and ensure vendors meet contractual and technical obligations. Design assurance & governance Review and approve architecture designs, high-level designs (HLDs), and low-level designs (LLDs). Ensure consistency, completeness, and adherence to standards. Identify design gaps, conflicts, and risks, and drive resolution. Cross-domain coordination Ensure alignment between infrastructure, applications, and security domains. Validate readiness for system integrations and project dependencies. Handover & delivery closure Ensure all infrastructure deliverables are complete prior to handover. Validate readiness for transition to operations teams. Ensure proper documentation, knowledge transfer, and closure compliance. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field. 15+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, with strong experience in leading infrastructure delivery within complex projects. Technical expertise Deep experience in infrastructure technologies including network architecture (routing, switching, security); systems, virtualization, and enterprise infrastructure platforms. Strong understanding of infrastructure design and architecture principles; integration dependencies across systems; security and segmentation concepts. Leadership & delivery Proven track record in owning infrastructure scope within large-scale projects. Strong experience in managing vendors and enforcing delivery quality. Ability to operate independently and drive outcomes. Governance & standards Extensive experience in design reviews, validation, and enforcing standards. Familiarity with cybersecurity and regulatory frameworks. Soft skills Strong leadership presence and decision-making capability. Ability to challenge vendors and stakeholders constructively. High accountability and ownership mindset. Preferred Experience in large-scale or critical infrastructure environments. Overview We are seeking an experienced attorney (Counsel) to join the Venture Capital Transactions Legal Practice in the Project Development & Finance Law Department of the Saudi Aramco Law Organization. The Joint Venture Development Legal Practice within the Law Organization is responsible for, among other matters, advising on, negotiating, and documenting Saudi Aramco’s VC transactions and providing legal support to assist with managing Saudi Aramco’s VC portfolio. Key Responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: Lead the legal activities with respect to the negotiation and execution of financing transactions in all contexts, including for parent company bank debt, joint venture project financings, and/or capital markets issuances, among others, including the structuring, negotiation, and documentation of such transactions. Advise management and internal clients with respect to Saudi Aramco’s legal rights and obligations, agreements, and common statutory or similar requirements in connection with financing transactions. Assist law management and other attorneys in identifying and examining the law and facts pertinent to legal problems. Liaise and work with outside counsel to negotiate and document transactions. Minimum Requirements As a successful candidate you will have: A Juris Doctorate degree or equivalent. Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident. A minimum of 7 years of project VC experience. Experience comprised of a combination of law firm and in-house experience in a corporation handling VC transactions. Demonstrable experience working directly with clients from transaction inception to completion of VC transactions. Hands-on experience with structuring, drafting, negotiating, and leading transactions in a first or second chair capacity. Experience with venture capital principles. Experience in the oil and gas, refining, chemicals, power or other energy-related industries (including renewable energy and new energies). Advanced AI Operations (AIOps) & Agentic Knowledge Ecosystem Project overview The objective of this project is to develop and deploy a sophisticated AI ecosystem leveraging Expert Digital Engineer's capabilities to transition from traditional RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to an Agentic AI Framework. Technical scope & core capabilities Agentic AI Architecture Multi-agent orchestration: Implementation of a multi-agent system using LangGraph to manage complex, non-linear workflows where specialized agents collaborate to solve technical problems. Agentic RAG & Graph RAG: Transition from vector-only search to Graph RAG, utilizing Knowledge Graphs to maintain relationships between complex engineering entities. Implementation of MCP (Model Context Protocol) to standardize how AI agents interact with external data sources and tools. Prompt engineering: Systematic development and optimization of prompt templates to ensure high-precision outputs for technical engineering queries. Tool integration & automation Engineering tool invocation: Enabling the AI agents to programmatically trigger and interface with specialized industry software, including: Hysys (Process Simulation) OLGA (Transient Flow Simulation) Ansys (Engineering Simulation) External dependencies: Management and procurement of necessary APIs and third-party middleware required to bridge the AI ecosystem with legacy engineering software. Knowledge management & governance Interactive indexing: Development of a feedback loop where subject matter experts (SMEs) can correct or refine indexed data, improving the Knowledge Graph over time. Document control: Versioning controls: Implementation of tracking to ensure the AI retrieves the most current revision of a technical document. Narrow search (filtering): Advanced filtration layers to restrict search scopes to specific projects, dates, or document types. Observability: Integration of Langfuse for tracing, debugging, and monitoring the performance and latency of AI chains and agent decisions. Functional applications & business deliverables Engineering & project support Master plan development: Utilizing AI to synthesize data for the study and development of corporate Master Plans and large-scale projects. Technology evaluations: Automating the benchmarking and evaluation of new technologies against existing corporate standards. Project reviews: AI-driven support for eReview and HAZOP (Hazard and Operability Study) participation, providing instant access to safety standards and historical data. Operational excellence & maintenance Incident investigation: Supporting major incident investigations by correlating telemetry data with historical reports via Graph RAG. Regulatory & corporate compliance: Automated generation and issuance of quarterly crude quality reports. Systematic updates to corporate engineering standards. Support for corporate program inspections (environmental, safety, etc.). Job description At SLS The Red Sea, every exceptional dining experience is supported by a seamless operation behind the scenes. As an Assistant Chief Steward, you will play a key role in supporting the stewarding operation and ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, organization, and efficiency across our culinary and food service areas. Working closely with the Chief Steward and culinary leadership, you will assist in leading the stewarding team, coordinating daily operations, and ensuring that all kitchens, equipment, utensils, and back-of-house areas are maintained to the high standards expected at SLS. Your hands-on approach, attention to detail, and ability to support and motivate the team will contribute to a safe, efficient, and well-organized environment that enables our culinary teams to deliver exceptional dining experiences. Key responsibilities Support the Chief Steward in coordinating daily stewarding operations and ensuring smooth workflow across all assigned areas. Supervise stewarding colleagues during daily operations, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently and in accordance with established standards. Ensure kitchens, back-of-house areas, equipment, utensils, and dishwashing areas are maintained to a consistently high standard of cleanliness and sanitation. Monitor the correct use, cleaning, and handling of kitchen equipment, utensils, dishwashing machines, and stewarding tools. Assist with daily staff allocation, task assignments, and operational coverage based on business requirements. Monitor the availability and appropriate use of cleaning chemicals, supplies, and stewarding equipment, reporting shortages or issues promptly. Support proper waste segregation, disposal, and recycling practices in line with hotel standards and sustainability initiatives. Conduct regular checks of operational areas to ensure cleanliness, organization, safety, and readiness throughout the day. Support the implementation of HACCP, food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and occupational health and safety standards. Assist in training, coaching, and guiding stewarding team members to maintain consistent operational and cleanliness standards. Promote teamwork, discipline, accountability, and a positive working environment within the stewarding team. Communicate operational requirements clearly and address day-to-day issues promptly, escalating matters to the Chief Steward when required. Work closely with the culinary and F&B teams to ensure their operational needs are supported efficiently and professionally. Assist in maintaining readiness for internal inspections, audits, and health and safety checks. Maintain a visible presence during busy operational periods and provide hands-on support to the team when required. Step in for the Chief Steward in their absence, ensuring continuity of daily stewarding operations and maintaining established standards. Qualifications Minimum of 2–3 years of relevant stewarding experience, ideally within a 5-star hotel, luxury resort, or upscale hospitality environment. Previous supervisory or team-leading experience within a stewarding or kitchen environment is preferred. Good knowledge of sanitation standards, hygiene practices, food safety requirements, and HACCP principles. Familiarity with commercial kitchen equipment, dishwashing systems, cleaning procedures, and stewarding operations. Ability to supervise, motivate, and support a diverse team in a fast-paced hospitality environment. Strong organizational, communication, teamwork, and time-management skills. Basic computer literacy and the ability to follow operational procedures and maintain basic records. Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to cleanliness, safety, and operational standards. Commitment to teamwork, continuous learning, and maintaining the high standards of SLS The Red Sea.

Job description At SLS The Red Sea, excellence starts at the source. As a butcher, you will play an important role in supporting our culinary operations by preparing premium meat products to the highest standards of quality, precision, freshness, and presentation. Working closely with the sous chef and wider culinary team, you will be responsible for cutting, trimming, deboning, portioning, and preparing a variety of meat products according to established specifications and operational requirements. Your craftsmanship and attention to detail will contribute to the consistency and quality of dishes across our culinary outlets. From receiving and inspecting meat deliveries to maintaining proper storage, mise en place, hygiene, and food safety standards, your contribution will support an efficient kitchen operation and exceptional dining experiences at SLS The Red Sea. Key responsibilities Cut, trim, debone, grind, portion, and prepare a variety of meat products according to established specifications and quality standards. Prepare and portion meat products to ensure consistency in quality, size, weight, and presentation across kitchen operations. Receive and inspect meat deliveries, ensuring product quality, freshness, temperature, and specification compliance. Package, label, store, and rotate meat products correctly to maintain freshness, quality, and food safety. Maintain daily mise en place and ensure all required products are prepared and ready for service. Maintain clean, organized, and hygienic workstations, tools, and equipment to prevent cross-contamination. Follow HACCP, food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and applicable health and safety requirements at all times. Monitor product quality and report any food safety concerns, equipment issues, or product discrepancies to the appropriate supervisor. Monitor stock levels and communicate product requirements or shortages to the culinary team in a timely manner. Minimize food waste through efficient cutting, portioning, trimming, storage, and responsible use of ingredients. Support other culinary areas when required, contributing to smooth and efficient kitchen operations. Use butchery equipment safely and responsibly, following established operating procedures and training guidelines. Participate in training and development opportunities to enhance butchery techniques, product knowledge, and culinary skills. Work collaboratively with the sous chef, chef de cuisine, and wider culinary team to support seamless service and consistent food quality. Maintain a professional, respectful, and positive working environment aligned with the values and standards of SLS The Red Sea. Qualifications Formal culinary training or a certificate/diploma from a recognized culinary institution is preferred. Minimum of 3 years of relevant butchery experience, ideally within a hotel, luxury resort, high-end restaurant, or professional food production environment. Strong knowledge of meat preparation, butchery techniques, kitchen operations, food safety, and hygiene standards. Good knowledge of butchery tools, equipment, and safe handling practices. Strong attention to detail with good organizational and time-management skills. Ability to work efficiently under pressure and maintain consistent quality in a fast-paced kitchen environment. Ability to follow instructions accurately and work effectively as part of a diverse culinary team. Flexible to work varied shifts, including weekends and holidays, according to business requirements. Passion for food quality, craftsmanship, and delivering exceptional dining experiences.

Collaborate with the chef de cuisine and executive chef to develop innovative, seasonal, and sustainable pastry and dessert concepts across all outlets. Ensure consistently high standards of preparation, presentation, flavor, and quality across all pastry and bakery products. Drive creativity and innovation through menu development, emerging patisserie trends, guest feedback, and new culinary techniques. Oversee recipe development and adherence, portion control, product consistency, and presentation in line with SLS brand standards. Manage pastry production planning and ensure efficient execution across all outlets and service periods. Monitor food costs, inventory, ordering, stock rotation, and resource utilization to support profitability and minimize waste. Proven expertise in advanced pastry techniques, bakery operations, dessert development, and culinary innovation. Strong knowledge of food safety, HACCP standards, sanitation practices, and kitchen management systems. Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and inspire a diverse culinary team in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational and planning skills with exceptional attention to detail, quality, and deadlines. Excellent understanding of food cost, inventory management, waste reduction, and resource optimization. A creative and innovative mindset with a genuine passion for pastry, bakery, and delivering memorable guest experiences. Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Job purpose To conduct independent, risk-based audits of construction projects, evaluating governance, internal controls, contract management, procurement, and compliance processes to provide assurance, identify risks, and recommend improvements that support effective project delivery and organizational objectives. Key accountability areas Construction project audits: Plan and perform internal audits of construction projects in accordance with the approved audit plan and professional auditing standards. Ensure audit assignments are completed in accordance with internal audit methodologies and professional standards. Technical / functional competencies Audit best practices Audit planning Audit reporting Auditing procedures / standards Compliance audits Internal audit controls Post audit reviews Security audits

Job description As director of revenue at Faena The Red Sea, you will be pivotal in driving strategic revenue management initiatives across the portfolio. Your insights and leadership will directly influence demand optimization, pricing strategies, and financial performance, helping us deliver on our promise of exceptional luxury and guest experiences. Key responsibilities: Monitor and support Faena Hotels by analyzing group and transient business trends over a five-year horizon, ensuring measurable improvements in demand, availability, and revenue. Deliver critical, data-driven analysis on short-term revenue impacts, influencing occupancy, average daily rate (ADR), and overall rooms profitability within the 53-week operational period. Engage actively in daily revenue meetings, sales strategy sessions, and property visits to ensure alignment and agile response to market conditions. Analyze STAR reports and RevPAR index changes, applying insights to forecast trends and guide revenue strategies. Develop and share revenue management best practices that enhance portfolio-wide performance. Stay attuned to industry, market, and economic trends, communicating findings to leadership and guidance teams. Partner with marketing to drive demand during low periods through targeted campaigns and strategic offers that boost bookings and revenue. Lead monthly forecast reviews with a goal of maintaining forecast accuracy within ±15% across all properties. Support the annual operating plan and develop an annual revenue management strategy aligned with Faena’s vision. Cultivate relationships with brand partners, ownership, third-party online travel agencies, and industry groups like HSMAI and local educational institutions. Support high-level displacement analysis and revenue decisions for group business, including extended stays. Guide the annual RFP process with strategic insights and oversight. Train sales and front office teams on revenue management principles and tools, empowering them to maximize revenue potential. Champion the effective use of revenue management technology across all properties and brands within the portfolio. Qualifications Proven experience (minimum 7–10 years) in revenue management within luxury or lifestyle hospitality brands, preferably managing multi-property portfolios. Strong expertise in forecasting, pricing strategies, and demand management to maximize RevPAR and overall revenue performance. Proficient in revenue management systems such as IDeaS, Duetto, or similar platforms, along with hotel PMS and CRM tools. Data-driven mindset, with the ability to analyze STAR reports, market trends, and financial data to inform strategic decisions and revenue plans. Collaborative team player with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and operations teams. Demonstrated leadership abilities, with experience training and mentoring teams to enhance revenue management knowledge and capabilities. Deep understanding of market dynamics in the Middle East and Saudi Arabia is highly desirable. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Exceptional problem-solving and strategic thinking skills, with attention to detail and a results-oriented approach. Knowledge of hospitality industry standards, brand positioning, and guest experience excellence.

job_title: Risk Advisory And Enterprise Risk Management
description: Scope of work This interim advisor will handle the heavy lifting specifically mapping our core process value chain, defining our risk appetite, and structuring our predictive, AI-driven risk models. This ensures that when our permanent hire arrives, they inherit a highly functional, well-structured ecosystem rather than starting from absolute scratch. We are seeking an experienced, high caliber risk advisor on an immediate term to rapidly design, build, and launch our foundational Enterprise Risk Management function. This role requires a strategic thinker who can seamlessly bridge the gap between abstract risk theory and practical corporate execution, tailoring the entire framework to our organizational value chain and advanced technological footprint. Key responsibilities: Map the organization’s end-to-end value chain and core processes to ensure the risk taxonomy directly reflects how the business generates value. Establish a clean, multilevel risk hierarchy L1 (Strategic, Operational, Financial, Compliance, and Technology Risk) and L2 & L3 detailed subcategories designed to drive accountability and distinct ownership without introducing administrative complexity. Map risk categories to the existing organizational structure, corporate values, and lines of accountability, ensuring every identified risk has a clear executive owner. Review the taxonomy for logical gaps, functional overlaps, and duplicate labels to ensure a clean data model. Embed the taxonomy into daily business operations by explicitly linking it to internal controls, risk events, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), reporting lines, and the overall risk appetite. Build a comprehensive assessment matrix utilizing four critical risk dimensions (Likelihood, Impact/Severity, Velocity, Interdependency). Create a unified scoring model that synthesizes these dimensions into actionable risk ratings (Low, Medium, High, Critical). Establish clear guidelines for three tiers of assessment (Qualitative, Semi-Quantitative, Quantitative). Design and document the formal ERM lifecycle process flow (Establish Context, Risk Identification, Risk Analysis, Risk Evaluation, Risk Treatment, Monitoring & Review, Communication & Reporting). Design the blueprints for integrating AI-driven tools into the ERM program, enabling predictive risk identification rather than purely retrospective reporting. Formulate requirements for NLP tools to automate risk sensing. Conceptualize early warning systems and automated KRI tracking dashboards driven by AI to flag threshold breaches in real time. Required qualifications & experience: Active Consultant, Manager, or Senior Manager (Risk Advisory, ERM). Deep, practical knowledge of global risk standards (COSO ERM Framework, ISO 31000). Proven capability in quantitative modeling (Monte Carlo, VaR) and a strong conceptual grasp of how AI/ML models can optimize risk management. Exceptional communication skills, with a track record of advising executive teams and translating complex risk data into business strategy. Demonstrated ability to build structured corporate programs from the ground up within tight, high-pressure timelines. Position details Location: Saudi Arabia Industry: Consulting Experience required: 12 years

Program summary KBR, through the AFCAP V Program, assists the U.S. Air Force by offering Southwest Asia Logistics Support (SWA Log). Job summary The logistics technician performs property accountability, inventory management, equipment handling, warehouse support, transportation coordination, and BEAR equipment yard operations at the assigned location. The position is responsible for maintaining accurate records for BEAR equipment, Mission Ready Spares Packages, R-14 accountable property, R-15 consumable items, Airfield Damage Repair equipment, tools, and shop equipment. The logistics technician will use automated inventory equipment, prepare logistics documentation, coordinate equipment movements, and support the receipt, shipment, transfer, and disposition of government property. Roles and responsibilities Conduct monthly physical inventories of BEAR equipment, MRSP kits, R-14 property, R-15 consumable items, ADR assets, tools, and shop equipment. Compare physical inventories against accountability records and identify missing, excess, damaged, or incorrectly recorded property. Update inventory records and ensure monthly inventory reports are completed accurately and submitted by the required deadline. Record shipments, receipts, transfers, turn-ins, and DLA Disposition Services transactions on the applicable inventory. Research missing items through physical inspections, record reviews, online research, and coordination with current or previously assigned personnel. Support the primary equipment custodian with R-14 and R-15 property-accountability requirements. Initiate transfer-of-accountability requests, equipment turn-in requests, and disposition actions. Prepare DD Form 1149 shipment documentation. Coordinate with the Transportation Management Office for outbound shipments and inbound property. Schedule pickup and delivery appointments for property movements. Perform the physical movement of property that can be safely transported using the contractor-provided pickup truck. Track accountable tools and shop equipment using barcode scanners, laptops, asset tags, and automated inventory-management software. Apply, replace, and maintain barcode labels and asset-identification tags. Maintain transaction suspense logs and follow up on open logistics actions until completed. Monitor deployed equipment listings, redistribution orders, and property-transfer actions. Maintain continuity files and supporting records for all property transactions. Maintain and organize the BEAR equipment yard. Segregate equipment by type, condition, and serviceability code. Load and unload trucks and assist with equipment re-warehousing. Operate 4,000-pound, 6,000-pound, and 10,000-pound forklifts when authorized and required. Coordinate the transfer of unserviceable equipment and excess property to DLA Disposition Services. Prepare and coordinate supporting traffic movement requests. Assist with recommendations concerning replacement, redistribution, or disposition of BEAR and WRM assets. Report unsafe conditions, damaged equipment, property discrepancies, and operational concerns to site leadership. Follow all installation safety, security, tool-control, and property-accountability requirements. Perform other logistics and property-management duties as assigned. Basic qualifications U.S. National (USN) with an active Secret Security Clearance. Relevant experience in logistics, supply, warehouse operations, property accountability, inventory management, transportation, or equipment management. Experience conducting physical inventories and reconciling inventory records. Ability to maintain accurate electronic and hard-copy property documentation. Ability to operate barcode scanners, laptops, inventory software, and standard office applications. Ability to prepare logistics forms and supporting shipment documentation. Must be certified, or capable of becoming certified, to operate 4K, 6K, and 10K forklifts. Ability to safely load and unload trucks and move equipment within warehouses and equipment yards. Ability to lift, carry, push, pull, and position materials and equipment consistent with job requirements. Previous AFCAP, Air Force, Department of Defense, War Reserve Materiel, or contingency logistics experience. Experience with BEAR equipment, MRSP inventories, R-14 and R-15 accountability reports, DLA Disposition Services, and DD Form 1149 documentation. Experience with barcode-based inventory systems, including WASP Asset Cloud or comparable systems. Overview We are seeking a curator of art and culture to join the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra). The King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra) is a leading cultural institution dedicated to enriching lives through culture, creativity, knowledge, and learning. Through its museums, exhibitions, educational programs, conferences, and cultural initiatives, Ithra preserves and promotes cultural heritage while creating meaningful experiences that inspire local and international audiences. Ithra is committed to presenting world-class museum experiences that connect history, creativity, and innovation while fostering dialogue and cross-cultural understanding. Your primary role is to develop, manage, and interpret art exhibitions, collections, and cultural initiatives that present art as a living tradition. You will bridge the historical and contemporary dimensions of art by delivering world-class exhibitions, strengthening local and international collaborations, advancing research and scholarship, developing educational programs, and creating engaging museum experiences that resonate with diverse audiences while supporting the preservation and appreciation of cultural heritage. Duties and responsibilities Manage the research, curation, content development, interpretation, and delivery of permanent, temporary, inaugural, and traveling art exhibitions from concept through implementation. Develop compelling exhibition narratives that connect historical collections with contemporary artistic and cultural practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Ithra to plan, develop, and deliver exhibition projects, conferences, and cultural programs. Manage the development of content, educational vision, interpretation, and programmatic plans for dedicated civilization galleries and interactive museum spaces. Oversee the growth, preservation, documentation, and stewardship of permanent and temporary art collections, including securing and managing significant long-term loans and historical installations. Assess art objects and historical architectural elements to support collection management, conservation planning, exhibition development, and interpretation. Establish, develop, and maintain collaborative partnerships with local and international museums, galleries, cultural institutions, researchers, and subject matter experts. Conduct scholarly research and develop publications, books, exhibition catalogues, and interpretive content related to art, aesthetics, visual culture, and traditional crafts. Develop and facilitate educational programs, community workshops, symposia, conferences, open lectures, and public engagement initiatives that promote the preservation and revival of traditional arts and crafts. Conduct audience research to understand visitor needs and develop exhibitions that are accessible, engaging, and relevant to diverse local and international audiences. Manage contracts and coordinate the work of external designers, artisans, consultants, and service providers to develop exhibition components and interactive displays. Provide curatorial expertise and guidance to multidisciplinary project teams while managing project budgets, schedules, resources, and stakeholder engagement. Represent Ithra at regional and international conferences, professional forums, networking events, and cultural engagements to strengthen institutional partnerships and promote art and culture. Minimum requirements You will hold a bachelor’s degree in art, art history, museum studies, or a related discipline from a recognized and approved program. A master’s degree or PhD is preferred. You will have 10–15 years of experience in art curation, museum management, cultural heritage, or museum exhibitions, including at least 5 years managing major museum exhibitions, gallery development, collection management, or curatorial programs. You will have demonstrated expertise in art, history, visual culture, and cultural heritage. You will have experience curating art collections, developing exhibitions, and managing museum collections within a major museum or cultural institution. You will have experience establishing partnerships and collaborating with local and international museums, galleries, cultural institutions, and subject matter experts. You will have a strong record of scholarly research, publications, books, or exhibition catalogues related to art. You will have experience managing multidisciplinary teams, project budgets, contracts, and external service providers. You will possess strong communication, writing, presentation, and public speaking skills. You will have the ability to engage diverse audiences through educational programming, audience research, and innovative museum experiences. You must be willing to travel internationally for research, networking, institutional collaboration, and collection acquisition. Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in Arabic or another language relevant to the world is highly desirable. Formal training or certifications in museology, museum studies, or art conservation are preferred. description: Job overview The Head of Workers' Welfare & Wellbeing is a pivotal role, driving the project's strategic vision and ESG commitments. This leader will define and execute welfare strategies, provide expert guidance, and ensure compliance with international standards and Saudi Labor Law. They will lead a diverse team, oversee assurance processes, and represent the client in critical welfare and human rights discussions with key stakeholders. Project duration: 5 months Key responsibilities Define and execute an enterprise-wide Workers' Welfare & Wellbeing Strategy, aligning with client's strategic objectives and ESG commitments. Establish governance structures and escalation pathways to integrate welfare considerations into project planning and execution. Provide executive-level advice on welfare performance, human rights risks, and regulatory compliance matters. Serve as the custodian of client's Workers' Welfare Standards, ensuring policies are developed, benchmarked, and aligned with international frameworks. Mandate the inclusion of welfare obligations in project contracts, including EPC, EPCM, and labor supply agreements. Lead the enterprise assurance framework, overseeing contractor prequalification, risk audits, and compliance management. Provide oversight and recommendations for non-compliance issues, ensuring timely and effective corrective actions. Maintain an auditable evidence base to support executive reporting, lender reviews, and government inspections. Direct the labor rights compliance program, ensuring worker-facing practices meet client's high standards and legal obligations. Lead systemic remediation efforts and manage the enterprise worker voice and grievance mechanism, ensuring accessibility and confidentiality. Qualifications and experience Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Law, Industrial Relations, or a related field, with a preference for a Master's degree or equivalent. Minimum 22 years of progressive experience in workers' welfare, human rights, labor relations, or related fields. 8-10 years of leadership experience at the Director level or equivalent, preferably in complex, multi-contractor environments. Demonstrated success in leading enterprise-wide welfare, assurance, or compliance programs in major projects. Expert knowledge of Saudi Labor Law, MHRSD requirements, and international frameworks like IFC Performance Standard 2 and ILO Conventions. Advanced understanding of modern slavery and forced labor risk frameworks, and experience in ethical recruitment practices. Strong leadership and management skills, with a track record of building and leading high-performing, multi-disciplinary teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, with a proven ability to represent organizations externally. Analytical mindset, proficient in interpreting data, identifying trends, and making data-driven decisions. Fluency in English and Arabic is highly desirable.

Job purpose Lead the Strategy Management Office (SMO) in developing, implementing, and monitoring the organization's strategic plan. Ensure alignment between strategic objectives and operational execution, support performance management, and enable informed decision-making across departments. Ensure that the business plans align with alfanar Electric strategy. Promote engagement and foster alignment among stakeholders to drive strategy execution. Continuous improvement: Continuously benchmark and assess best practices in strategy management to enhance organizational effectiveness. Promote a culture of strategic thinking, performance accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the organization. Role accountability HR proficiency: Ability to recruit, recognize, and cultivate high performers and develop them in order to create a robust second line of management. Ability to recognize low performers and guide them to improve or release them. Ability to treat subordinates fairly and without bias. Assessment criteria of subordinates is performance that leads to planned results. Ensure availability of delegation of authority matrix to have sufficient delegations as per company policy. Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them. Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions. Delivery: Deliver the required results in a timely manner with required quality and cost. Making a tangible difference: Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation and exceed business expectations. Business planning and performance: Able to transform the corporate goals into business plans. Able to plan, follow up, and execute those plans, whether they are annual or development plans. Monitor the plan performance and initiate action to strengthen results and take corrective action accordingly. Provide periodic work progress reports. Responsible for monitoring and controlling budgets and expenses to achieve optimum cost efficiency. Organizational development: Develop the organizational structure according to the current requirements taking into consideration future and development plans. Ensure availability of job descriptions for all job roles and deployment. Business process improvements: Develop, coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities as much as possible. Should be conversant and able to navigate through IT solutions especially those relevant to his job and business. Promote the automated systems and using them fully, to spread its culture. Quality: Quality is considered alfanar’s prime competitive advantage; as such, managers are expected to act accordingly. Adaptation: Adapt to new and alternative techniques, technologies, management structures, and business models. Health, safety and environment: Ensure a safe, secure, and legal work environment as per the standard regulations. Job description The Landscape Supervisor is responsible for supervising the daily maintenance and presentation of the hotel's gardens, lawns, trees, irrigation systems, and outdoor landscaped areas. Assign daily tasks and monitor the performance of gardeners and landscape attendants. Ensure landscaped areas are maintained to the hotel's luxury standards. Conduct routine inspections and identify areas requiring maintenance or improvement. Monitor seasonal planting, pruning, fertilization, mulching, and lawn care activities.
