Overview of the role The Stock Controller/Inventory Controller plays a crucial role in retail operations by ensuring accurate tracking and availability of inventory. This position demands adherence to operating procedures to minimize stock loss risks and improve efficiency. Working both independently and as part of a team, the controller oversees stock levels, discrepancies, and reporting, while coordinating with relevant departments and external partners to maintain seamless inventory management. Success in this role requires precision, problem-solving skills, and effective communication with suppliers and teams. The ability to navigate financial aspects and asset management as well as participate in business planning adds value to the role's strategic importance. What you will do Track shipments and control product inputs and outputs from warehouses and other stores. Escalate stock discrepancies during receiving to suppliers or senders by raising SRD reports and coordinating until adjustments are made in the system. Maintain and update stock records in both incoming and outgoing log books and the system. Conduct stock accuracy checks and investigate shortages weekly, segregate damaged stock, ensuring movement of damaged units for updating in the system. Verify periodically the physical quantities in stock with software records and undertake corrective measures in case of discrepancies by coordinating with brand teams, MIS, AM, and OPM. Prepare the store for marketing events, arrange stock count procedures, and ensure easy scanning and counting of stocks. Accurately record missing barcodes, quality, quantity, type, and other inventory characteristics and send updates to the brand team for assistance. Be physically present during maintenance work activities in the store, often after store closing hours. Participate in annual business planning and manage monthly budgets. Create purchase orders, track invoices, ensure completion of work with SLA, and invoice by Service Provider as required. Manage non-merchandise assets stored inside stock rooms for business-related activities. Required skills to be successful Inventory management expertise, including tracking and reporting. Excellent problem-solving abilities in a retail context. Effective communication skills in English and Arabic. Organizational skills for coordinating stock and assets. What qualifies you for the role Diploma or high school education required. A minimum of 1-2 years in retail stock handling role, preferably in KSA. Strong skills in handling large shipments and accuracy in stock counting. Proficiency in English and Arabic to communicate effectively with vendors and delivery personnel. Overview We are seeking a petrophysicist with expertise in reservoir characterization to join the Eastern Unconventional Characterization Division (EUCD) within the UR Exploration & Characterization Department. EUCD is responsible for exploring unconventional targets in the kingdom, including shale targets, tight clastic, and tight carbonate formations, as well as characterizing existing unconventional resources to validate their viability and de-risk their development program. Additionally, the department provides support to other entities within UR organization to address any subsurface challenges that may arise during various operational stages, ultimately facilitating informed decision-making and optimized resource development. Your primary role is to integrate petrophysical data from various sources, including well logs, cores, and laboratory measurements, to perform detailed reservoir evaluations, create accurate petrophysical models, and predict reservoir properties such as porosity, permeability, and fluid saturation. Key responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: Leading and building petrophysical models from multidisciplinary data and observations to establish accurate reservoir properties and predict hydrocarbon volumes. Conducting detailed petrophysical studies integrating all available data to optimize well placement, completion, and production designs to maximize hydrocarbon recovery. Use and maintain petrophysical models to conduct and document reservoir characterization workflows via generating cross sections from well logs, maps, cores, cross plots, histograms, summary tables, and written reports for different stratigraphic intervals to recommend optimal well placement strategies. Evaluate current practices and identify opportunities for innovative improvements using data science applications to predict reservoir quality and optimize hydrocarbon recovery. Demonstrate the ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously by actively participating in the well planning process to optimize well placement using a variety of petrophysical data. Monitoring and tracking wells during and post-completion operations. Effectively communicate through presentations to technical peers and management teams to enhance in-house knowledge. Provide support, recommendations, and advice in the area of expertise. Mentor and develop young professionals on applying petrophysical principles to support drilling, completion, and production. Remain up-to-date with latest industry trends, best practices, and technologies in petrophysics. Minimum requirements As the successful candidate you will have the following: A bachelor’s degree in geosciences, geophysics, or a related engineering discipline. An advanced degree is preferred. 10 years or more of experience in petrophysical industrial and active technical roles, with at least 5 years in reservoir characterization. Experience in building, maintaining, and evaluating large and complex petrophysical models utilizing industry software e.g. Techlog, Petrel, Geolog, and other relevant software. Working knowledge in the integration of well logs, cores, and laboratory measurements to predict reservoir properties and optimize hydrocarbon recovery. Demonstrate the ability to work within a multi-disciplinary team in an operational environment that requires interactive and proactive approaches to predicting and solving petrophysical related issues which impact reservoir characterization, well placement, and hydrocarbon production. Peer-reviewed published work in the subject matter will be an added value. description: About Four Seasons: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us. About the location: Soon to be one of the region’s foremost luxury beachside destinations, The Red Sea will comprise of the idyllic natural islands and lagoons across 200 kms of coastline along the western coast of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh. The new Four Seasons Resort will be located on Shura Island, the hub of the development and home to a yacht marina, leisure and lifestyle facilities, retail offerings, 18-hole golf course and more. The Red Sea destination is being built with sustainable practices and tourism at its core, with the masterplan being informed by an impressive marine spatial planning simulation to model the environmental impact of development and operations to minimize over-tourism while providing guests with an exceptional travel and lifestyle experience. The destination will also rely on renewable energy and will only develop a small portion of the islands with expansive dedicated conservation zones. The new Four Seasons Resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites, all with uninterrupted views over white sand beaches and crystal-clear waters. The property will also feature six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery centre, Kids for All Seasons space and much more. Whether looking for rest and relaxation or sport and water activities, there will be something for everyone, including a full-service spa with a hammam, tennis courts, three outdoor pools with cabanas, and two separate beaches for families and adults perfect for soaking in the sun or diving down to explore the coral reefs. About the Roles: Night Cleaner As a Night Cleaner at Four Seasons Resort Red Sea, you play a vital role in upholding the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene in our public and employee areas. Working primarily during non-business hours, you ensure that all designated spaces are spotless, sanitized, and welcoming for guests and colleagues alike. Your responsibilities include thorough cleaning tasks such as mopping, vacuuming, dusting, and disinfecting surfaces. You also manage waste removal efficiently to maintain a tidy environment. By working behind the scenes, you help create a fresh, organized atmosphere that supports daily operations and enhances the overall guest experience. Public Area Attendant As a Public Area Attendant, you are responsible for maintaining immaculate public spaces and restrooms throughout Four Seasons Resort Red Sea. Your vigilance and care ensure these areas are clean, orderly, and well-stocked, reinforcing the resort’s commitment to excellence. Your daily duties include dusting, vacuuming, mopping, and sanitizing all public surfaces with attention to detail. You regularly inspect the condition of public areas to identify and promptly report any maintenance or cleanliness issues. In addition, you ensure restrooms are consistently supplied with essentials such as toilet paper, soap, hand sanitizers, and paper towels, maintaining both hygiene and guest convenience. Turndown Attendant The Turndown Attendant at Four Seasons Resort Red Sea is responsible for creating a serene and inviting evening environment in guest rooms. Arriving in the early evening, you refresh and prepare rooms for the guest’s nighttime comfort. Your duties include tidying the room, replenishing amenities, closing drapes, adjusting lighting, and providing small touches such as placing chocolates or a personalized note. Your attentive service helps guests unwind and enjoy a restful night’s sleep, embodying the Four Seasons promise of thoughtful luxury and care. Knowledge and Skills Ability to read, write, and speak English. What to Expect: Competitive basic salary in a tax-free environment Travel allowance 30 days’ vacation 10 days public holidays per year Paid home leave tickets Complimentary employee meals Medical insurance Life insurance Employee assistance program Worldwide complimentary room nights with Four Seasons Laundry/dry cleaning provided for work attire Growth and development opportunities

Revenue management Develop and implement revenue strategies to maximize RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, and total hotel revenue. Analyze historical data, booking trends, market demand, and competitor activities to optimize pricing strategies. Manage dynamic pricing across all distribution channels. Monitor pace, pick-up, booking windows, cancellations, and no-show trends. Conduct daily, weekly, and monthly revenue analysis and recommend pricing adjustments. Prepare accurate demand forecasts and business projections. Lead revenue meetings and present recommendations to the Executive Committee. Optimize room inventory and manage overbooking strategies when appropriate. Monitor displacement analysis and evaluate group business opportunities. Ensure effective inventory allocation across all distribution channels. Distribution management Manage all Online Travel Agencies (OTAs), Global Distribution Systems (GDS), brand channels, and direct booking platforms. Ensure reservation inquiries are handled professionally and promptly. Monitor reservation accuracy and compliance with hotel standards. Ensure booking confirmations are processed accurately. Manage room blocks, allotments, waitlists, and special requests. Review and approve reservation exceptions when required. Ensure guest preferences are communicated to operational departments. Commercial collaboration Work closely with Sales & Marketing to develop promotional offers and packages. Evaluate group quotations and determine optimal pricing strategies. Support corporate negotiations through revenue analysis. Coordinate with Front Office to maximize upselling opportunities. Partner with Marketing to optimize direct booking initiatives. Financial & reporting Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and annual revenue reports. Analyze revenue variances and recommend corrective actions. Leadership Lead, coach, and develop the Reservations Team. Conduct performance evaluations and regular coaching sessions. Develop departmental SOPs and service standards. Ensure compliance with Accor and Mantis brand standards. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and guest-centric service. Compliance Ensure compliance with company policies and brand standards. Maintain confidentiality of pricing and commercial information. Adhere to Saudi Labour Law and company procedures. Experience with pre-opening hotels is an advantage. Experience within Accor, Ennismore, or international hospitality brands is preferred. Proven track record of leading high-performing HR teams and partnering with senior leadership to drive business objectives, engagement, and operational excellence. Structured into five operating divisions: automotive, financial services, real estate, retail, and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia, and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand, responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate. By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration, and integrity, Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day. Overview of the role As we continue to expand our business, welcome new brands into our portfolio, and strengthen our Saudization initiatives, we are looking to hire Saudi nationals who can contribute to our next phase of growth. In this role, you will be responsible for accelerating sales growth for Commercial Vehicles by identifying new business opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, and closing profitable deals. This is an exciting opportunity for a results-oriented sales professional with a passion for commercial vehicles and a strong understanding of the KSA market. What you will do Proactively identify and win new customers within your assigned territory and target accounts. Achieve and exceed monthly and annual sales targets while protecting revenue and margin performance. Conduct regular customer visits, prospecting activities, and market outreach to build a strong sales pipeline. Lead product presentations, demonstrations, and test drives that support conversion. Maintain accurate CRM records and provide timely sales activity and pipeline reporting. Required skills to be successful Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Three years of commercial vehicle sales experience within a dealership environment. Mandatory KSA truck sales experience is required, along with a proven track record of exceeding sales targets. Strong knowledge of light, medium, and heavy-duty trucks, proficiency in Microsoft Office, and a valid KSA driving license are essential for this role. About the team You will be part of Al-Futtaim Industrial Equipment & Commercial Vehicles (FAMCO), working within the Commercial Vehicles sales function and reporting to the Sales Manager – Commercial Vehicles. The team is focused on driving growth, strengthening market presence, and delivering exceptional customer experiences across the KSA commercial vehicle sector. We are looking for someone with a hunter mindset, high resilience, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage time effectively in a fast-paced sales environment. A proactive approach, self-motivation, and a strong focus on results will be key to success in this role. Position objective The position is responsible for increasing business revenues. The position is responsible for developing, implementing and maintaining standard operating procedures required as per retail standards across stores to drive the business and gain customer satisfaction. Oversee the recruiting, hiring and training needs of the store, and efficient decision making to enhance the overall performance of the store. Represent the brand by maximizing and contributing to the sales within the store through exceptional customer service and retail experience. Provide leadership and support to all the employees. Key responsibility Sales and profitability: Achieve quantitative measures of performance in the following areas: units per transaction, average transaction value, sales per month, sales per square feet, sales turnover, shrinkage control, increase in conversion percentage. Effective management of the operational costs, reduction in operational costs by automation. Interpret and make decision on operations and visual standards based on store and client’s needs. Formulate a succession plan, in conjunction with the brand general manager. Set KPI’s and KRA’s for direct reportees and conduct performance appraisal and feedback. Involve in the selection and recruitment of the operational staff, when required. Ensure technical and behavioral proficiency of staff through appropriate learning and development initiatives. Communication: Conduct regional sales and operations meetings on regular basis. Provide frequent feedback to the area managers and store managers on their performances, in relation to company's performance. Ensure brand participation in loyalty programme ‘Club Apparel’. Weekly meeting with GM and senior management to discuss business plan vs achievements and improvement areas. Stock management: Monitor store inventory in consultation with brand general manager and brand managers. Promote a proactive relationship between GM, area manager, brand manager, store manager and the buyers/planners thereby maximizing sales. Monitor slow-moving and out-dated stock, in consultation with brand managers. Ensure stock security measures are effectively managed by store managers. Store design and projects management: Involve in the design and layout process of the new store projects. Design a "New Store Schedule" prior to commencement of design process. Provide guidance to concept architect during the design and implementation process. Conduct regular project update meetings with the projects team. Provide guidance and support to territory during set-up and merchandising phase. Miscellaneous: Ensure enhanced brand visibility and provide inputs for marketing and brand awareness. Handling legal responsibilities related to store management, store opening, and planning.

Job description Position summary The Director of Reservations is responsible for leading the Reservations Department and ensuring the effective management of room reservations, inventory control, and reservation systems to maximize conversion, optimize room availability, and deliver exceptional service. The role works closely with the Director of Revenue Management, Sales, Front Office, Revenue, and Distribution teams to ensure reservation accuracy, inventory integrity, and seamless guest experiences, particularly during high-demand periods including Hajj, Ramadan, and Umrah. Key responsibilities Reservations operations Lead and manage the daily operations of the Reservations Department. Ensure all reservations are processed accurately and within brand standards. Maintain reservation quality, guest communication, and response times. Supervise reservation team and ensure service excellence. Monitor reservation queues and booking turnaround times. Handle VIP, group, and complex reservation requests. Ensure reservation policies are consistently followed. Inventory & availability management Manage room inventory in coordination with the Revenue Management team. Ensure room availability is accurately reflected across all booking channels. Monitor room allocation, restrictions, stop-sell periods, and overbooking levels. Coordinate room releases during Hajj, Ramadan, and peak demand periods. Ensure rate codes, packages, and promotions are loaded correctly. Distribution systems Ensure accurate setup and maintenance of Opera PMS and Accor reservation systems. Coordinate with Distribution and Revenue teams regarding channel connectivity. Monitor reservation interfaces and system performance. Ensure reservation data integrity across all systems. Revenue support Support the Director of Revenue Management in implementing approved pricing strategies. Monitor pickup trends and booking pace. Prepare daily reservation and pickup reports. Identify unusual booking patterns and communicate them promptly. Assist with forecasting by providing reservation insights and booking trends. Team leadership Recruit, train, coach, and develop the Reservations team. Conduct performance evaluations and continuous coaching. Ensure compliance with Accor brand standards. Build a high-performing, guest-focused reservations team. Cross functional collaboration Work closely with Front Office to ensure room readiness and arrival planning. Coordinate with Sales regarding group blocks and contracted allocations. Support Finance with reservation audits when required. Collaborate with Marketing regarding promotional offers and campaigns. Reporting Prepare daily pickup reports. Produce weekly reservation performance reports. Monitor booking pace against forecast. Track reservation conversion. Analyze booking source performance. Monitor cancellations and no-show trends. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management, Business, or related field. 3–5 years of experience in revenue and reservation management roles within a luxury or upper-upscale hotel environment (Accor experience preferred). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. Experience with IDeaS Revenue Management System and Opera PMS highly desirable. In-depth knowledge of online distribution channels, OTA management, and dynamic pricing models. Excellent communication, presentation, and collaboration skills. Fluent in English; proficiency in Arabic is an advantage. High level of integrity, attention to detail, and ability to perform under pressure — especially during peak seasons. Additional information Enjoy discounted Heartist® rates across Accor’s global network of 5,600 properties and 10,000 food and beverage venues. Access continuous learning and development through Accor’s Revenue Management Academy and leadership programs. Opportunity to grow your career globally across 45+ Accor brands in over 110 countries. Work with industry-leading tools including the IDeaS Revenue Management Platform. Be part of one of Makkah’s most iconic hotels, serving guests from all over the world. Why work for Accor? By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo!

About Four Seasons: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us. About the location: Soon to be one of the region’s foremost luxury beachside destinations, The Red Sea will comprise of the idyllic natural islands and lagoons across 200 kms of coastline along the western coast of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh. The new Four Seasons Resort will be located on Shura Island, the hub of the development and home to a yacht marina, leisure and lifestyle facilities, retail offerings, 18-hole golf course and more. The Red Sea destination is being built with sustainable practices and tourism at its core, with the masterplan being informed by an impressive marine spatial planning simulation to model the environmental impact of development and operations to minimize over-tourism while providing guests with an exceptional travel and lifestyle experience. The destination will also rely on renewable energy and will only develop a small portion of the islands with expansive dedicated conservation zones. The new Four Seasons Resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites, all with uninterrupted views over white sand beaches and crystal-clear waters. The property will also feature six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery centre, Kids for All Seasons space and much more. Whether looking for rest and relaxation or sport and water activities, there will be something for everyone, including a full-service spa with a hammam, tennis courts, three outdoor pools with cabanas, and two separate beaches for families and adults perfect for soaking in the sun or diving down to explore the coral reefs. About the role: As a Kids For All Seasons Supervisor at Four Seasons Resort Red Sea, you play a key role in ensuring the success of the resort’s children's program by overseeing daily operations and engaging young guests in fun, safe, and enriching experiences. You lead by example, creating a nurturing, professional, and joyful environment for children while supporting and guiding the KFAS team. Your passion for child engagement, creativity, and hospitality excellence ensures that the resort delivers memorable moments for our youngest guests and peace of mind for their families. Key responsibilities: Daily operations & guest experience: Supervise the day-to-day activities of the Kids For All Seasons facility and ensure smooth operations during assigned shifts. Lead engaging, age-appropriate activities such as arts & crafts, storytelling, nature walks, sports, and themed events. Welcome children and parents warmly, ensuring they feel safe, informed, and valued. Observe children during play and activities to ensure a safe and inclusive environment for all. Team collaboration & support: Guide, support, and mentor KFAS Attendants in delivering fun, structured, and high-quality programming. Assist in training new team members on safety protocols, Four Seasons service standards, and child engagement practices. Promote a positive and collaborative team culture by leading through example. Health, safety & cleanliness: Ensure the KFAS facility and materials are kept clean, organized, and fully stocked. Enforce health, safety, and hygiene protocols at all times. Monitor and report any concerns, incidents, or equipment issues promptly and professionally. Service & communication: Provide exceptional guest service to both children and parents. Communicate guest feedback and programming ideas to management for continuous improvement. Maintain daily records of child participation and activity schedules. Qualifications & skills: Previous experience working with children in a hospitality, childcare, or educational setting (minimum 1–2 years). Experience in a supervisory or team lead role is preferred. Creative, energetic, and passionate about working with children of various age groups. Strong communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills. Fluent in English; knowledge of Arabic and/or other languages is a plus. First Aid and CPR certification required (or willingness to obtain). Ability to work flexible schedules, including weekends and holidays. What to expect: Competitive net salary in a tax-free environment Travel allowance if applicable 30 days’ vacation 10 days public holidays per year Paid home leave tickets Complimentary employee meals Medical insurance Life insurance Employee assistance program Worldwide complimentary room nights with Four Seasons Laundry/dry cleaning provided for work attire Growth & development opportunities

Job description Perform, coordinate and execute sales activities for assigned dealt accounts, overview and monitor the market and the competitors to ensure established Etihad sales targets are reached contributing to Etihad’s profitability objectives achievement. Accountabilities Define, agree and execute plan of sales activity to ensure targets are reached using all the available tools, data and insights provided by sales strategy and planning. Analyse the market potential to determine the value of existing and prospective customers in terms of sales opportunities and use the sales toolkit to convert them to revenue premium. Collect, review and consolidate information to support the identification of intervention areas for the regional business development to ensure sales target achievement and introduction of new products and services relevant to your customer. Cooperate with global sales enablement to determine the best promotion sales techniques. Communicate and regularly meet with accounts to inform about new products and promotions to ensure the best and most updated value proposal is timely communicated to the market. Coordinate and draft contractual agreements with accounts to ensure customer requirements are captured effectively and in compliance with existing policies. Negotiate and manage commercial agreements with assigned accounts to ensure sales can be closed, respecting corporate guidelines and indications. Complete all Etihad commercial training and act as a thought leader in your area of specialism. Maintain the customer data current in Etihad’s CRM tool. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with 3 years of relevant experience in sales. Managing multiple stakeholders from various departments to achieve our goals. Relevant commercial and analytical work experience. Position summary: Position requires a skilled MH-60/H-60 avionics technician AT with the ability to perform planned maintenance interval inspections (PMI), organizational, intermediate, and depot level maintenance on H-60 helicopters, which also includes troubleshooting, testing, inspections, repairs of aircraft radios, radar, navigation equipment, and other rapid communication devices. Extensive knowledge in wire and connector repair is required. Position is in Jubail Saudi Arabia. Essential responsibilities: Current or previous experience performing H-60 helicopter avionics work to include but not limited to: Perform maintenance and repair of major assemblies, subassemblies, and wire and connector replacements on the MH-60R aircraft and related systems. Have a knowledge of electronic theory. Perform inspection, troubleshooting, fault detection, fault isolation, and appropriate corrective actions on electrical and utilities systems. Operate and maintain all applicable ground support equipment. Identify, use and maintain all common, special, and precision tools available for power plant maintenance and repair. Responsible for all maintenance documentations, applicable forms, records, and reports using appropriate references and other publications including the NAMP. Provide on-the-job-training (OJT) for Saudi technicians and other personnel to include maintaining appropriate training records to document training. Minimum position knowledge, skills, and abilities required: Eight years current or previous experience performing complex helicopter electrical work to include but not limited to: installation, tests, troubleshooting, repair, overhaul, alignments, modification, performing final test calibrations, and solving maintenance problems in highly complex navigation identification, radar electronic devices, navigational radar, electronic countermeasure systems, global positioning system (GPS), and armament systems. Must be able to solve complicated problems encountered by pilots while in flight. Often these problems cannot be duplicated on the ground. Have a thorough understanding of flight characteristics and their effects on electronic systems. Systems include search/navigational radar, communication, navigation, electronic countermeasures, data computing, recording equipment, weapons computer, and inertial measurement systems. Be able to use test equipment such as voltmeters, signal generators, sweep/pulse generators, dual trace oscilloscopes, deviation meters, sweep carts, precision power, and frequency measuring devices. Also, must use various test sets that detect discrepancies that often do not appear during bench rework in work centers. Ability to read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, schematic diagrams, and technical directives. Work with miniaturized solid-state circuits and devices. Able to use a full range of hand tools common to the trade. Must have a thorough knowledge of digital/analog computers, algebra, and trigonometry. Must be able to pass a background check and drug test. Preferences: Navy aviation avionics - AT MH-60R HSM HSC Airborne low-frequency sonar (ALFS): AN/AQS-22 Sonobuoy processing system Multi-mode radar: AN/APS-153(V) Open-architecture mission computer Clearance requirement: Must be able to obtain and maintain a DoW secret clearance. Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. A drug-free workplace is maintained and post offer, pre-employment substance abuse testing is performed. US citizenship is required to obtain a secret clearance. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. Must be able to walk and stand on level, inclined surfaces for certain periods throughout the day. Also be able to climb stairs, ramps, ladders, and work stands. Must be able to lift 50 pounds. Distinguish color and judge three-dimensional depth. Category management Build and execute category strategies tailored to customer demographics and store profile. Review category performance weekly and recommend actions to improve sales and profitability; introduce new ranges based on trends; phase out slow-moving and underperforming products. Analyse customer buying behaviour, market trends, and competitor activity to identify opportunities and optimise product assortments. Merchandise planning Create annual and seasonal plans, forecast demand and inventory needs, allocate stock across stores, and maintain optimal product mix while minimizing excess inventory. Ensure the right product mix is maintained in every store. Inventory management Monitor inventory health across all categories, improve turn and sell-through, reduce aged and obsolete stock. Develop action plans for slow-moving stock. Manage full product life cycles and partner with vendors on replenishment. Optimise inventory investment and working capital while maximising stock productivity and return on inventory. Sales and performance analysis Track sales units, average selling price, gross profit and margin, sell-through, stock turn, weeks of cover, and category contribution. Identify growth opportunities and produce regular performance reports. Visual merchandising Set merchandising guidelines and planograms to ensure consistent in-store presentation. Optimise display space by performance and conduct regular store visits and merchandising audits. Product and range management Build balanced assortments across price points and brands. Manage launches and seasonal collections, recommend exits, and secure exclusive ranges with suppliers. Pricing and promotions Recommend pricing and markdown strategies, evaluate promotional effectiveness, and support marketing with the right product selection while protecting margin. description: Company description Why work for Accor? We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities. Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLESS Job description The director of marketing, digital & communications is responsible for shaping and elevating the hotel's brand positioning, reputation, visibility, guest desirability and digital performance across all touchpoints. As a key member of the leadership team, this role leads the development and execution of integrated marketing, communications, public relations, social media, content, partnerships, e-commerce and digital strategies, ensuring the hotel is positioned as one of the leading luxury hospitality destinations in Makkah. The role is responsible for driving both brand equity and measurable commercial performance across rooms, restaurants, wellness and ancillary revenue streams. Acting as both a brand guardian and cultural ambassador, the director ensures that all communications, storytelling, partnerships and guest engagement initiatives reflect the elegance of the Sofitel brand while respecting the cultural and social significance of the destination. Working closely with revenue management, sales, operations and regional commercial teams, the director ensures all marketing and digital initiatives contribute to revenue growth, guest engagement and the long-term success of the hotel. Key responsibilities, among others: Strategy, positioning & commercial planning: Develop and execute the annual marketing, communications and digital marketing strategy aligned with brand objectives and commercial priorities. Act as guardian of the hotel's cultural link and positioning framework, ensuring all campaigns, partnerships, storytelling and guest experiences remain aligned with the property's identity and brand narrative. Contribute actively to strategic planning, budgeting and forecasting processes. Define annual digital revenue targets for direct and indirect channels. Build annual digital marketing plans and budgets covering all digital channels and performance levers. Identify strategic partnerships, collaborations and cultural opportunities that strengthen visibility, guest engagement and brand desirability. Work closely with revenue management and sales teams to ensure alignment between commercial objectives and marketing initiatives. Marketing, communications & public relations: Lead the hotel's integrated marketing, communications and PR strategy across all guest-facing channels. Oversee media relations, brand campaigns, partnerships, storytelling and activations in line with the luxury positioning of the hotel. Build and maintain strong relationships with media, tourism stakeholders, luxury partners, cultural institutions and key industry contacts. Drive local, regional and international visibility through impactful storytelling and strategic communications. Manage content direction including photography, videography, editorial storytelling and campaign production, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints. Manage external agencies, creative partners, photographers, videographers and production suppliers. Digital marketing & e-commerce: Own the full e-commerce and digital strategy across direct and indirect channels, accountable for digital revenue across rooms, F&B, wellness and ancillary streams, and for the optimal mix between channels. Drive direct performance through the hotel websites, booking engine and wider direct channel, optimising the guest journey and direct-booking growth. Own the indirect channel strategy, managing visibility, content and commercial terms to grow market share and revenue contribution. Own the paid media budget and channel mix across SEM, metasearch, display, social, and OTA optimising spend for return across both direct and indirect. Oversee CRM initiatives, database growth, segmentation and guest lifecycle communications. Hold digital campaigns and agencies accountable for measurable ROI, lead generation and conversion, keeping the property ahead of emerging platforms and consumer trends. Own digital measurement and attribution, analytics, tracking and dashboards, as the single source of truth for digital performance across all channels. Stay abreast of emerging digital platforms, technologies and consumer trends to identify new opportunities for growth. Social media & content strategy: Define and oversee the hotel's social media strategy to strengthen awareness, engagement and community growth. Ensure all content reflects the luxury standards, visual identity and cultural relevance of the brand. Identify emerging social trends, creators, influencers and partnership opportunities. Lead content planning, creation and publishing across all social channels. Monitor and optimise social media performance and audience engagement. Online reputation & guest engagement: Manage the hotel's online reputation and guest sentiment across all review platforms. Monitor guest feedback and identify opportunities to improve the guest experience. Work closely with operations and guest relations teams to address guest concerns and enhance satisfaction. Leverage guest insights and reviews to support marketing and commercial strategies. Performance analytics & market intelligence: Analyse campaign performance, website analytics, digital marketing data and market intelligence. Monitor competitor activity, tourism trends and luxury consumer behaviour. Track key performance indicators including website traffic, engagement, conversion, revenue contribution and ROI. Prepare regular performance reports and strategic recommendations for the executive committee. Utilise third-party intelligence tools and market insights to identify revenue opportunities and support decision-making. Leadership & talent development: Serve as a member of the hotel's leadership team, contributing to the overall strategic direction and success of the property. Lead, motivate and develop a high-performing marketing, digital & communications team. Create an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, ownership and continuous improvement. Identify and nurture talent through coaching, mentoring and succession planning. Champion brand culture and inspire the team to deliver exceptional marketing, storytelling and guest engagement initiatives. Ensure team objectives are aligned with the hotel's commercial priorities and long-term brand vision. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, hospitality management, business or a related field. Minimum 8–10 years' experience in luxury hospitality marketing, communications, digital marketing or e-commerce leadership roles. Proven experience leading integrated marketing, communications and digital strategies within a luxury hospitality or lifestyle environment. Strong understanding of luxury brand positioning, storytelling and guest engagement. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate brand initiatives into measurable business results. Strong understanding of SEO, SEM, CRM, social media, website management and digital marketing platforms. Experience managing PR agencies, creative partners, digital agencies and production suppliers. Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Fluent in English and Arabic. Additional information Our commitment to diversity & inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

description: Aramco energizes the world economy Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society. Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply. We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization. Overview We are seeking a crisis communications and issues management specialist to join our Monitoring and Coordination Division. The Monitoring and Coordination Division is responsible for handling monitoring of Aramco’s media mentions and dealing with crisis communications. Your primary role is to assess and deal with crisis and reputation issues when they happen. Additionally, develop mitigation plans and responses to media questions, also review and update the corporate crisis communications manual and conduct drills and training for staff. Duties and responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: Update the crisis communications manual on a monthly basis, gain approval, and prepare copies for management on a quarterly basis. Assist business lines with their crisis communications manuals and training requirements. Ensure that the media room is running and updated with current technology and equipment. Conduct weekly video conference testing in collaboration with other functions. Respond to incidents or issues that have the potential to damage the company’s reputation. Prepare communications as needed during an incident or threat to the company’s brand. Support corporate communication strategic initiatives by developing and maintaining a crisis plan. Prioritize and manage multiple projects and initiatives within a busy media team. Leverage available enterprise data and research (e.g. corporate reputation tracking data and stakeholder insights) to inform future communication strategies, content creation and engagement. Develop KPIs and metrics to measure the effectiveness and impact of crisis communications strategies. Provide functional support and advice on crisis media issues to senior leaders in the organization. Attend cross functional crisis drills, provide support and ensure accountability reporting on outcomes of attendance and participation at such events. Support the company’s crisis communications activities, crisis preparedness, and media handling during crisis incidents. Minimum requirements You will hold a bachelor’s degree in the fields of mass communications, risk management, public relations, journalism, crisis management, or related field from a recognized and approved program. You will have 10 years of experience in developing crisis communication strategies. About the location: Soon to be one of the region’s foremost luxury beachside destinations, The Red Sea will comprise of the idyllic natural islands and lagoons across 200 kms of coastline along the western coast of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh. The new Four Seasons Resort will be located on Shura Island, the hub of the development and home to a yacht marina, leisure and lifestyle facilities, retail offerings, 18-hole golf course and more. The Red Sea destination is being built with sustainable practices and tourism at its core, with the masterplan being informed by an impressive marine spatial planning simulation to model the environmental impact of development and operations to minimize over-tourism while providing guests with an exceptional travel and lifestyle experience. The destination will also rely on renewable energy and will only develop a small portion of the islands with expansive dedicated conservation zones. The new Four Seasons Resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites, all with uninterrupted views over white sand beaches and crystal-clear waters. The property will also feature six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery centre, Kids for All Seasons space and much more. Whether looking for rest and relaxation or sport and water activities, there will be something for everyone, including a full-service spa with a hammam, tennis courts, three outdoor pools with cabanas, and two separate beaches for families and adults perfect for soaking in the sun or diving down to explore the coral reefs. Overview of the role We are looking for a Credit Control Executive to join our Finance team in Riyadh. This role will be responsible for managing credit deals, assessing credit applications, monitoring accounts receivable, and supporting timely collections across the business. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring credit approvals are completed in line with the delegation of authority, agreed service level agreements, and internal credit control processes. What you will do Review and verify supporting documents for credit assessments, ensuring accuracy, validity, and completeness. Prepare credit assessment reports and submit them for approval as per the defined process. Ensure credit approvals are completed within the agreed SLA and in line with the delegation of authority. Update approved credit terms in SAP Customer Credit Master and maintain the credit approval tracker. Monitor customer accounts for non-payments, delayed payments, and other irregularities, and follow up with Business Finance and Sales teams for resolution. Coordinate with FSSC O2C and Business Finance to ensure customer payments are accounted for on time and unallocated credits are resolved. Develop accounts receivable reports and analysis, highlighting collection issues and delinquent accounts to management. Support periodic credit reviews by coordinating with the Head of Corporate Credit and Business Heads to maintain appropriate credit limits and payment terms. Conduct client field visits when required to support collections and relationship management. Required skills to be successful Strong understanding of credit control, credit assessment, and accounts receivable processes. Minimum 2 years’ experience in financial analysis, credit control and accounts receivable. Ability to prepare reports, track credit approvals, and identify collection risks. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, for reporting and analysis. About the team You will be part of the Finance function supporting credit and receivable control for FAMCO KSA. The role works closely with Business Finance, Sales teams, FSSC O2C, Corporate Credit, and Business Heads to ensure credit decisions, collections, and customer account follow-ups are managed effectively. What equips you for the role Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience in preparing credit assessments, AR reports, and credit approval trackers. Working knowledge of SAP or similar ERP systems. Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate across finance, sales, and shared service teams. Ability to support timely reporting, follow-ups, and resolution of overdue or irregular customer accounts. Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills. Good analytical skills with strong attention to detail and accuracy. Fluency in Arabic and English. Job summary Functions as the strategic business leader of the property's hotel operations. Areas of responsibility may include front office, recreation/health club, housekeeping, food and beverage/culinary, and engineering/maintenance. Position works with direct reports (department heads) to develop and implement departmental strategies and ensures implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives. The position ensures hotel operations meet the brand’s standards, targets customer needs, ensures employee satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues, and maximizes the financial performance of the department while developing positive owner relations. Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and employees and provides a return on investment. Core work activities Managing profitability Demonstrates and communicates key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand’s target customer. Analyzes service issues and identifies trends. Makes and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals. Works with hotel management team to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution. Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy and rate, wages, and controllable expenses. Reviews the wage progress report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holding team accountable for results. Leading operations and department teams Champions the brand’s service vision for product and service delivery and ensures alignment amongst the hotel leadership teams. Develops systems to enable employees to understand guest satisfaction results. Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results. Stays visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels, and overall satisfaction. Creates an atmosphere in all rooms and food and beverage areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations. Managing and conducting human resources activities Facilitates the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and ensures implementation to continually improve guest satisfaction results. Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably. Ensures that regular, ongoing communication is happening in operations (e.g., pre-shift briefings, staff meetings). Fosters employee commitment to providing excellent service, participates in daily stand-up meetings, and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and employees. Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of staff/operations meetings with an emphasis on generating innovative ways to continually improve results. Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance. Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door policy,” and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns. Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to standard and local operating procedures (SOPs and LSOPs), and supports the peer review process. Conducts annual performance appraisal with direct reports according to standard operating procedures. Champions change, ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented, and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary. Program summary: The KBR PSAB program provides comprehensive base operating support-installation (BOS-I) services at Prince Sultan Air Base (PSAB) in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA). Job summary: The Prince Sultan Air Base (PSAB) laborer foreman is responsible for supporting the power plant services in providing escorting support to Third Country National (TCN)/Other Country National (OCN) escorting and monitoring and for the completion of required reports and tasks following the established policies, procedures, systems, and requirements approved by the company and the USAF. Responsibilities: Process personnel to and from the PSAB Visitors Control Center before and after work shifts in accordance with USCENTCOM escorting procedures. Provide escorting support to Other Country Nationals (OCNs) in various CES and FSS areas as identified by the site manager. Escort un-cleared personnel into areas and monitor personnel performing maintenance and BOS-I services. Log in and out all TCN/OCN contractors and count personnel before and after they perform duties; notify appropriate personnel of how many people and vehicles are being escorted. Make contact with TCN/OCN personnel at designated entry facility after they are processed for entry and receive their exchange badges; provide and brief them on rules and procedures. Monitor TCN/OCN work until it is completed for the day and the work zone has been purged by trained Force Protection military personnel and all LNs/OCNs have exited base and/or returned to camps. Ensure TCN/OCNs do not bring onto the base any prohibited or contraband items (i.e., weapons, drugs, etc.). Maintain sight of all vehicles and personnel when performing TCN/OCN monitor duties. Provide for safety and welfare of oneself and monitored personnel (such as evacuating to protective shelter in case of attack). Notify project/site manager and the safety staff as soon as possible of unsafe working conditions. Maintain an alert state of readiness and be prepared to properly respond to any situation that may occur; alert appropriate personnel of any suspicious behaviors or comments of TCN/OCNs. Perform a wide range of administrative and other support services to deliver BOS-I. Coordinate activities in support of managers and supervisors to facilitate the efficient operation of the project/site. Be responsible for the completion of required reports and tasks of the project in accordance with the established policies, procedures, systems, and requirements approved by the company. Under direct supervision, perform routine assignments and duties to provide services to PSAB. Support the site leadership to fulfill contractual reporting requirements to the United States Government. Demonstrate excellent communication skills with all levels of management and interface with client personnel and subcontractors. Promote and uphold KBR’s Zero Harm safety program policies and procedures. Ensure the successful delivery of services to 4,000 personnel, plus or minus 10%. Perform other duties as assigned. Use of land mobile radios, cell phones, laptops, and other devices to maintain contact and accountability of work activities. Working environment: Work will be indoors and outdoors. Exposure to heat, cold, dust, noise, and chemicals may occur. Overtime and shift work may be required depending on contractual needs as well as occasional to frequent travel. Employee must comply with all federal, state, and local regulations and published company work rules as well as written instructions. Task specific work environment training may be provided. Skills: Proactive, well organized, results-oriented, and team player. Use computers and related software such as Microsoft Office and other common products used in office environments. Able and willing to work periods of long hours to meet mission requirements. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and customer service skills. Experience in contingency environments as well as knowledge and experience working with government contracts. Basic qualifications: High school diploma or equivalent. General knowledge and experience with facility and equipment operations and maintenance as well as with food and MWR services. Must be a U.S. citizen with a current U.S. driver’s license. Must possess a passport book (not passport card) with at least 13 months of remaining validity and 6 blank visa/stamp pages remaining. Must have and maintain a valid U.S. SECRET security clearance. Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English fluently. Candidate must also meet CENTCOM MOD-15 theater requirements. USAF experience is highly desired. About the location Soon to be one of the region’s foremost luxury beachside destinations, The Red Sea will comprise of the idyllic natural islands and lagoons across 200 kms of coastline along the western coast of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, between the cities of Umluj and Al Wajh. The new Four Seasons Resort will be located on Shura Island, the hub of the development and home to a yacht marina, leisure and lifestyle facilities, retail offerings, 18-hole golf course and more. The Red Sea destination is being built with sustainable practices and tourism at its core, with the masterplan being informed by an impressive marine spatial planning simulation to model the environmental impact of development and operations to minimize over-tourism while providing guests with an exceptional travel and lifestyle experience. The destination will also rely on renewable energy and will only develop a small portion of the islands with expansive dedicated conservation zones. The new Four Seasons Resort will offer approximately 149 rooms and suites, all with uninterrupted views over white sand beaches and crystal-clear waters. The property will also feature six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery centre, Kids for All Seasons space and much more. Whether looking for rest and relaxation or sport and water activities, there will be something for everyone, including a full-service spa with a hammam, tennis courts, three outdoor pools with cabanas, and two separate beaches for families and adults perfect for soaking in the sun or diving down to explore the coral reefs. Maintain accurate recruitment reports, hiring metrics, and compliance documentation. Support pre-employment processes including offers, background checks, and onboarding coordination. Promote Four Seasons as an employer of choice and deliver a positive candidate experience. What you bring Minimum 2–3 years of supervisory experience in talent acquisition or recruitment, preferably within luxury hospitality. Strong knowledge of recruitment best practices, interviewing techniques, and employer branding. Experience with HR systems and applicant tracking systems; Workday experience is an advantage. Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills. Previous pre-opening experience is an advantage. Fluent in English. What we offer Competitive salary in a tax-free environment. Fully furnished accommodation and transportation. 30 days annual vacation, plus public holidays. Paid round-trip home leave ticket. Complimentary meals and uniform care. Comprehensive medical and life insurance. Employee Assistance Program and global complimentary stays with Four Seasons. Career development opportunities within a world-class luxury brand. Schedule & hours Full-time position with flexibility to support recruitment events, interviews, and pre-opening timelines.

What you will create Sales strategy & revenue generation Develop and execute a comprehensive pre-opening sales strategy covering all segments: corporate, MICE, government, leisure, travel trade, and diplomatic accounts. Set and deliver ambitious revenue targets across rooms, F&B, events, and ancillary services. Build and manage the hotel's rate strategy, account portfolio, and sales pipeline from the ground up. Lead contract negotiations with key accounts, agencies, and government bodies, ensuring commercially sound and mutually beneficial agreements. Represent Faena Wadi Safar at industry events, road shows, and trade fairs locally and internationally. Government & institutional sales Develop and manage strategic relationships with government ministries, royal court entities, embassies, and quasi-government institutions. Position Faena Wadi Safar as the venue of choice for official state functions, VIP delegations, ministerial meetings, and government-hosted events. Identify and secure government room block agreements, long-stay contracts, and event partnerships. Collaborate with the general manager to respond to government RFPs and official invitations for proposals. Stay current on Saudi Vision 2030 initiatives and identify commercial opportunities that align with national priorities. Government relations & compliance oversight Serve as the hotel's senior representative in engagements with key government entities including the Ministry of Tourism, Ministry of Commerce, and regional authorities. Oversee the hotel's regulatory compliance and licensing requirements in partnership with the People & Culture and Finance teams. Build and maintain relationships with government contacts to facilitate smooth processing, issue resolution, and proactive communication. Monitor the regulatory landscape and brief leadership on changes with operational or commercial implications. Job description As chief concierge, you will lead the concierge team in delivering highly personalized experiences that reflect the bold, vibrant, and luxurious spirit of SLS. Act as the primary point of contact for VIP, repeat, and high-profile guests, ensuring personalized recognition and tailored service. Maintain extensive knowledge of SLS The Red Sea facilities, services, dining venues, wellness offerings, and destination experiences. Build and maintain strong relationships with local partners, tour operators, transportation providers, and destination stakeholders. Anticipate guest needs and proactively recommend experiences that enhance satisfaction and create memorable moments. Oversee concierge communications, guest correspondence, itinerary preparation, and follow-up activities. Manage concierge desk operations, staffing schedules, service standards, and departmental performance. Monitor guest feedback and implement service improvements to continuously enhance the guest experience. Collaborate closely with front office, guest relations, butler service, housekeeping, spa, food & beverage, and recreation teams to ensure seamless service delivery. Support arrival and departure experiences, including airport transfers, luggage handling coordination, and transportation logistics. Maintain accurate records of guest preferences and profiles to support personalized service and guest loyalty. Ensure compliance with hotel policies, safety procedures, and brand standards. Support pre-opening activities including SOP development, team training, service culture implementation, and operational readiness. Previous experience in a Forbes Travel Guide, Leading Hotels of the World, luxury lifestyle, or luxury resort environment preferred. Strong knowledge of luxury guest service standards and personalized service delivery. Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills. Proven ability to manage VIP guests and complex guest requests with discretion and professionalism. Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced environment. Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop high-performing teams. Proficiency in Opera PMS and Microsoft Office applications preferred. Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset. Knowledge of Saudi Arabia and the Red Sea destination is advantageous. Fluency in English required; additional languages are highly desirable. Passion for hospitality, storytelling, destination experiences, and creating unforgettable guest journeys.

Discreet, trustworthy, and highly organized—someone colleagues and leadership can rely on to protect the hotel's compliance standing at all times. Position summary: The Prince Sultan Air Base (PSAB) plumber/water and fuels systems maintenance technician is responsible to maintain, inspect, and repair plumbing, water, wastewater, fire suppression, and backflow prevention systems and components in accordance with the established policies, procedures, systems, and requirements approved by the company. Installs, services, and repairs all facets of plumbing from water heaters, urinals, toilets, and shower units. Provides leadership, instruction, and guidance to lower level craftsmen and may reassign work delegated from supervisor. Completes records, maintains tools and equipment, and performs various clean-up and housekeeping activities. Assemble, install, and repair pipes, fittings, and fixtures of heating, water, and drainage systems, according to specifications and plumbing codes in support of construction and maintenance activities. Assemble pipe sections, tubing, and fittings, using couplings, clamps, screws, bolts, cement, plastic solvent, caulking, or soldering, brazing, and welding equipment. Cut openings in structures to accommodate pipes and pipe fittings, using hand and power tools. Fill pipes or plumbing fixtures with water or air and observe pressure gauges to detect and locate leaks. Hang steel supports from ceiling joists to hold pipes in place. Knowledge of water heaters, pop-off valves or relief valves, and heating elements related to water heaters. Observe and follow all safety rules and procedures, including wearing required personal safety equipment. Perform other duties and activities as directed. Ensure the successful delivery of services to 4,000 personnel, plus or minus 10%. Employee must comply with all federal, state, and local regulations and published company work rules as well as written instructions. Task specific work environment training may be provided. Must possess passport book (not passport card) with at least 13 months of remaining validity and 6 blank visa/stamp pages remaining. Must have and maintain a valid U.S. SECRET security clearance throughout the duration of the contract. Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English fluently. Job Description We are seeking a Fire Safety Engineer to join our team. The Fire Safety Engineer is responsible for delivering technical fire and life safety engineering activities under the direction of the Fire Safety Engineering Lead. The role supports delegated Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) governance framework by conducting technical reviews, field assessments, inspections, compliance verification, fire risk assessments, and technical investigations within approved procedures and delegated authorities. The role prepares technical recommendations for review and approval through the Lead, Fire Safety Engineer and the Health and Safety Manager, as applicable. The Fire Safety Engineer also supports compliance with Saudi Civil Defense requirements, Saudi Building Code (SBC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), International Fire Code (IFC), and requirements by maintaining audit-ready evidence, verifying fire protection system performance, supporting Civil Defense-related documentation and inspections where applicable, and escalating significant fire and life safety risks. Review new construction, renovations, fire protection systems, and high-hazard facilities. Conduct fire risk assessments and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Ensure compliance with Saudi Building Code (SBC), Saudi Civil Defense, NFPA, IFC, and applicable fire safety requirements. Support inspection, testing, maintenance, commissioning, and verification of fire protection systems. Review systems including fire alarms, water-based and special suppression, smoke control, passive fire protection, fire doors, barriers, and means of egress. Investigate fire incidents, system failures, unwanted alarms, and other fire and life safety issues. Coordinate with projects, facilities, contractors, consultants, and other stakeholders. Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Fire Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related Engineering discipline. Minimum 6 years of professional experience in Fire Protection Engineering, Fire Systems, Fire Prevention, or Fire & Life Safety Compliance. Strong knowledge of SBC, NFPA, IFC, and Saudi Civil Defense requirements. Experience in fire protection system inspections, testing, commissioning, and compliance. Experience reviewing technical drawings, designs, specifications, and inspection documentation. International fire safety certifications such as CFPS, CFPE, NICET, IFE, or equivalent are preferred. Valid driver's license required.
